meaningEN: Important enough to have a noticeable effect.
commonMistakes: ❌ significant to the project → غالبًا ✅ significant for the project أو significant in the project حسب السياق.
examples: The study found a significant improvement in student performance.
There has been a significant increase in energy prices.
Exercise plays a significant role in maintaining health.
The results were statistically significant.
The new policy had a significant impact on employment.

meaningEN: A difficult task or situation requiring effort and determination; to question or oppose something.
commonMistakes: ❌ challenge with a problem → ✅ face a challenge. ❌ challenge to do something (بمعنى صعوبة) → ✅ the challenge of doing something. challenge + object عندما يكون المعنى يعترض أو يشكك.
examples: Climate change poses a major challenge for governments worldwide.
She accepted the challenge of leading the new project.
The findings challenge traditional beliefs about language learning.
Many students face financial challenges at university.
Overcoming challenges helps build resilience.

meaningEN: An advantage or positive effect; to receive or provide an advantage.
commonMistakes: ❌ benefit for studying → ✅ benefit of studying. ❌ benefit to do → ✅ benefit from doing. عند استخدام الفعل يأتي غالبًا benefit from + noun/gerund.
examples: Regular exercise provides numerous health benefits.
Many students benefit from online learning resources.
The main benefit of the new software is its speed.
Both countries benefited from the trade agreement.
The reforms will benefit future generations.

meaningEN: To exchange or convey information, ideas, or feelings effectively.
commonMistakes: ❌ communicate me the news → ✅ communicate the news to me. ❌ communicate about someone → ✅ communicate with someone about something.
examples: Effective managers communicate clearly with their teams.
She struggled to communicate her ideas during the presentation.
The system communicates data in real time.
Animals communicate through sounds and body language.
Good communication helps prevent misunderstandings.

meaningEN: The natural world or the surroundings and conditions in which people live, work, or develop.
commonMistakes: ❌ environment of the city → ✅ environment in the city. ❌ environment pollution → ✅ environmental pollution.
examples: Governments should protect the natural environment.
A positive learning environment improves student performance.
Children need a safe environment to grow and learn.
The company offers a flexible working environment.
Environmental issues affect every country.

meaningEN: A careful study to discover new facts or knowledge; to investigate systematically.
commonMistakes: ❌ do a research → ✅ do research. ❌ research about → ✅ research on / research into. كلمة research غير معدودة عندما تعني البحث بشكل عام.
examples: Scientists are conducting research on renewable energy.
Her research has influenced government policy.
More research is needed before drawing conclusions.
The company invested heavily in market research.
He spent years researching ancient civilizations.

meaningEN: A duty or obligation to deal with or take care of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ responsible of → ✅ responsible for. ❌ responsibility of doing → ✅ responsibility for doing. responsibility to someone = واجب تجاه شخص.
examples: Parents have a responsibility to protect their children.
She accepted responsibility for the mistake.
It is your responsibility to submit the report on time.
Businesses have a social responsibility to society.
The manager assumed full responsibility for the decision.

meaningEN: Suitable or correct for a particular purpose, person, or situation.
commonMistakes: ❌ appropriate in this situation → ✅ appropriate for this situation. ❌ appropriate with → ✅ appropriate for.
examples: Please wear appropriate clothing for the interview.
His comments were not appropriate for a formal meeting.
The teacher chose an appropriate example to explain the concept.
This software is appropriate for beginners.
Parents should use age-appropriate language with children.

meaningEN: To grow, improve, or create something gradually over time.
commonMistakes: ❌ develop on a skill → ✅ develop a skill. ❌ develop to → ✅ develop into عندما يتحول الشيء إلى حالة جديدة.
examples: Students should develop critical thinking skills.
The company developed a new medical device.
She developed an interest in psychology during university.
Strong relationships develop over time.
The disease may develop rapidly if left untreated.

meaningEN: Relating to or involving the whole world.
commonMistakes: ❌ global for the world → ✅ global in nature / worldwide. لا تقل global of the world.
examples: Climate change is a global challenge.
The company has a strong global presence.
Global demand for renewable energy is increasing.
Researchers are working on global health initiatives.
The internet has transformed global communication.

meaningEN: To give or assign something for a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ allocate for the project → ✅ allocate resources to the project. ❌ allocate someone something → يفضل allocate something to someone. استخدم allocate + object + to + person/purpose.
examples: The government allocated additional funds to public hospitals.
Managers should allocate resources efficiently.
Each department was allocated a separate budget.
The teacher allocated ten minutes for discussion.
The company allocated responsibility to experienced team leaders.

meaningEN: To evaluate or judge the quality, importance, or value of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ assess about the problem → ✅ assess the problem. ❌ assess of → ✅ assess مباشرة دون حرف جر.
examples: The committee assessed the candidates fairly.
Doctors assessed the patient's condition immediately.
It is important to assess the risks before investing.
Teachers assess students throughout the academic year.
The report assesses the impact of climate change.

meaningEN: To think something is true without having proof; to take on a role or responsibility.
commonMistakes: ❌ assume about → ✅ assume that... ❌ assume as → ✅ assume the role of...
examples: Many people assume that money guarantees happiness.
She assumed responsibility for the entire project.
Do not assume that everyone agrees with you.
The new manager assumed control of the department.
Scientists should not assume results without evidence.

meaningEN: To organize or carry out an activity; behaviour.
commonMistakes: ❌ make a research → ✅ conduct research. ❌ conduct to → ✅ conduct something.
examples: Scientists conducted a series of experiments.
Police are conducting an investigation into the incident.
The university conducted a survey among students.
She conducted the meeting professionally.
Employees are expected to maintain professional conduct.

meaningEN: To use, eat, drink, or spend something.
commonMistakes: ❌ consume from → ✅ consume مباشرة دون حرف جر. ❌ consume too much of resources → ✅ consume too many resources / too much energy.
examples: Modern buildings consume less energy than older ones.
Children should not consume excessive amounts of sugar.
Streaming services consume large amounts of internet data.
The project consumed more time than expected.
Developing countries consume fewer resources per person.

meaningEN: To give, add, or help bring about a result.
commonMistakes: ❌ contribute in → ✅ contribute to. ❌ contribute something for → ✅ contribute something to.
examples: Regular exercise contributes to better health.
Many volunteers contributed their time to the project.
Education contributes significantly to economic growth.
Everyone is encouraged to contribute ideas during the meeting.
Several factors contributed to the company's success.

meaningEN: To become less or refuse politely.
commonMistakes: ❌ decline from an invitation → ✅ decline an invitation. ❌ decline of prices (عند وصف الانخفاض) → ✅ decline in prices.
examples: Sales declined significantly during the recession.
She politely declined the job offer.
Scientists observed a decline in biodiversity.
The company's profits continue to decline.
There has been a sharp decline in unemployment.

meaningEN: To improve the quality, value, or effectiveness of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ enhance with skills → ✅ enhance skills. ❌ enhance of → ✅ enhance مباشرة دون حرف جر.
examples: Technology has enhanced communication worldwide.
Regular practice enhances language skills.
The update enhances system security.
Good lighting enhances the appearance of the room.
These measures will enhance customer satisfaction.

meaningEN: To keep something at the same level, condition, or standard.
commonMistakes: ❌ maintain on → ✅ maintain + object. ❌ keep maintain → استخدم maintain وحدها.
examples: The company maintains high standards of customer service.
Regular exercise helps maintain good health.
Researchers maintained strict quality controls throughout the study.
It is important to maintain a healthy work-life balance.
The government aims to maintain economic stability.

meaningEN: To need something or make something necessary.
commonMistakes: ❌ require for → ✅ require مباشرة دون حرف جر. ❌ require to do (إذا كان الفاعل هو الشيء) → ✅ require doing / require someone to do something حسب السياق.
examples: Success requires patience and persistence.
The position requires excellent communication skills.
Some plants require very little water.
The report requires further revision.
Applicants are required to provide proof of identity.

meaningEN: To obtain or gain something through effort, learning, or experience.
commonMistakes: ❌ acquire to → ✅ acquire + object مباشرة. ❌ acquire from experience → الأفضل acquire experience أو gain experience. استخدم acquire عندما يكون الاكتساب تدريجيًا أو رسميًا.
examples: Children acquire language naturally through interaction.
She acquired valuable management skills during her internship.
The company acquired two smaller businesses last year.
Students acquire confidence through regular practice.
Over time, he acquired a reputation for honesty.

meaningEN: To change in order to suit new conditions or make something suitable for a different purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ adapt with → ✅ adapt to. ❌ adapt in a new environment → ✅ adapt to a new environment. adapt something for use = يكيّف شيئًا لغرض معين.
examples: Employees must adapt to technological changes.
Animals adapt to their environment over time.
The novel was adapted into a successful film.
Good teachers adapt their methods to students' needs.
Businesses must adapt quickly to changing markets.

meaningEN: Enough in quantity or quality for a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ adequate enough → ✅ adequate فقط لأن معناها يتضمن الكفاية. ❌ adequate for doing → غالبًا adequate for + noun.
examples: The evidence was adequate to support the conclusion.
Students need adequate preparation before the exam.
The hospital has adequate medical equipment.
We had adequate time to complete the task.
The company provides adequate training for new employees.

meaningEN: Next to or very close to something.
commonMistakes: ❌ adjacent with → ✅ adjacent to. لا تستخدم beside إذا كان المقصود المصطلح الرسمي في الخرائط أو العقارات.
examples: The hotel is adjacent to the conference center.
Our office is adjacent to the main library.
The two countries share adjacent borders.
Parking is available in the adjacent building.
The laboratory is adjacent to the research facility.

meaningEN: Another choice, option, or method instead of the usual one.
commonMistakes: ❌ alternative for → ✅ alternative to. ❌ another alternative → يفضل alternative أو another option لأن alternative تعني بديلًا بالفعل.
examples: Solar power is an alternative to fossil fuels.
We need to find an alternative solution.
There was no alternative but to postpone the meeting.
Many people choose alternative methods of transportation.
The report suggests several alternative approaches.

meaningEN: To make changes to improve or correct something, especially a law or document.
commonMistakes: ❌ amend to the law → ✅ amend the law. amend = يعدّل الشيء مباشرة.
examples: The committee voted to amend the proposal.
Several articles of the constitution were amended.
The contract was amended before it was signed.
Lawmakers agreed to amend the legislation.
Please amend the report before submission.

meaningEN: Happening once every year.
commonMistakes: ❌ annual year → ✅ annual فقط. ❌ every annual meeting → ✅ the annual meeting / every year.
examples: The company published its annual report.
Our annual conference attracts thousands of participants.
Annual sales increased by 12 percent.
The museum hosts an annual exhibition.
Employees receive an annual performance review.

meaningEN: Easy to notice or understand; seeming to be true.
commonMistakes: ❌ apparent for everyone → ✅ apparent to everyone. ❌ it is apparent for → ✅ it is apparent that.
examples: It soon became apparent that the plan would fail.
The reason for the delay was not immediately apparent.
There is an apparent contradiction in the report.
Her disappointment was apparent to everyone.
The benefits became apparent after several months.

meaningEN: A method of dealing with something; to move closer to someone or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ approach to solve → ✅ approach to solving. ❌ discuss about the approach → ✅ discuss the approach.
examples: The company adopted a customer-centered approach.
We need a different approach to solving this issue.
Researchers approached the problem from a new perspective.
As winter approached, temperatures dropped rapidly.
She approached the manager to discuss her concerns.

meaningEN: Nearly correct but not exact; to estimate.
commonMistakes: ❌ approximate about 100 → ✅ approximately 100 / an approximate figure of 100. لا تستخدم about مع approximate إلا إذا اختلف المعنى.
examples: The approximate cost of the project is one million dollars.
Please provide an approximate arrival time.
The figures are only approximate.
Scientists approximated the distance using satellite data.
The journey takes approximately three hours.

meaningEN: To happen, appear, or begin to exist, especially unexpectedly.
commonMistakes: ❌ arise because → ✅ arise from / arise out of. ❌ arise a problem → ✅ a problem arises.
examples: Several problems arose during the construction process.
Misunderstandings often arise from poor communication.
New opportunities arise when markets expand.
Questions may arise during the presentation.
The conflict arose out of cultural differences.

meaningEN: A particular part, feature, or characteristic of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ aspect about → ✅ aspect of. ❌ many aspects in the problem → ✅ many aspects of the problem.
examples: Communication is an important aspect of leadership.
We examined every aspect of the proposal.
The financial aspect of the project requires careful planning.
Environmental aspects should not be ignored.
This issue has both legal and ethical aspects.

meaningEN: To give someone a particular job, duty, or piece of work.
commonMistakes: ❌ assign for someone → ✅ assign something to someone. ❌ assign someone with a task → ✅ assign someone a task / assign a task to someone.
examples: The manager assigned each employee a specific task.
Students were assigned a research project.
The teacher assigned the presentation to Sarah.
Responsibilities were assigned according to experience.
The committee assigned a high priority to the issue.

meaningEN: To help someone do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ assist someone to something → ✅ assist someone with something / assist in doing something. assist فعل رسمي أكثر من help.
examples: The nurse assisted the doctor during the operation.
Staff are always available to assist customers.
Technology assists in improving productivity.
She assisted with the preparation of the report.
The organization assists refugees in finding housing.

meaningEN: A group of things that share similar characteristics.
commonMistakes: ❌ category for → ✅ category of. ❌ categorize in → ✅ categorize into.
examples: Books are arranged by category in the library.
This product belongs to a different category.
Applicants are divided into several categories.
The disease falls into a rare category.
Researchers created a new category for the data.

meaningEN: A condition or situation affecting what happens.
commonMistakes: ❌ in this circumstance → غالبًا ✅ in these circumstances / under the circumstances. ❌ circumstance of → حسب السياق وغالبًا circumstances surrounding.
examples: Under the circumstances, we had no choice but to cancel the event.
Financial circumstances prevented him from studying abroad.
The accident occurred under unusual circumstances.
In certain circumstances, exceptions may apply.
Her personal circumstances changed dramatically.

meaningEN: To fall down suddenly or fail completely.
commonMistakes: ❌ collapse of tiredness → ✅ collapse from exhaustion. ❌ collapse because pressure → ✅ collapse under pressure.
examples: The bridge collapsed after the earthquake.
Several businesses collapsed during the financial crisis.
He collapsed from exhaustion after the race.
Negotiations collapsed at the final stage.
The market experienced a sudden collapse.

meaningEN: Related to business or intended to make a profit.
commonMistakes: ❌ commercial purposeS → غالبًا ✅ for commercial purposes. ❌ commercial of television → ✅ television commercial.
examples: The invention achieved commercial success.
This software is not licensed for commercial use.
The area is mainly commercial rather than residential.
Commercial banks offer a wide range of financial services.
The company released a new television commercial.

meaningEN: A formal group given a task; a payment based on sales; to officially request a piece of work.
commonMistakes: ❌ receive commission from sales → ✅ receive commission on sales. ❌ commission for a report → ✅ commission a report.
examples: The government established an independent commission.
Sales representatives earn commission on every sale.
The museum commissioned a famous artist to create a sculpture.
The report was commissioned by the Ministry of Health.
She receives a monthly salary plus commission.

meaningEN: A group of people living together or sharing common interests.
commonMistakes: ❌ community of people (غالبًا زائدة) → ✅ the community. ❌ in community → ✅ in the community.
examples: The project received strong support from the local community.
Community service teaches young people responsibility.
The international community condemned the attack.
She plays an active role in her community.
The university works closely with the surrounding community.
wordFamily: communicator (n. ليس مشتقًا مباشرًا في المعنى)

meaningEN: Consisting of many connected parts and therefore difficult to understand or deal with.
commonMistakes: ❌ very much complex → ✅ very complex / highly complex. ❌ complex for understand → ✅ complex to understand.
examples: Climate change is a highly complex issue.
The human brain is an extremely complex system.
Scientists are studying the complex relationship between diet and health.
The software is powerful but too complex for beginners.
Negotiating an international agreement is a complex process.

meaningEN: One of the parts that together make up a whole.
commonMistakes: ❌ component in a system → ✅ component of a system. ❌ component part (غالبًا تكرار غير ضروري) → ✅ component.
examples: Trust is a key component of a successful relationship.
Water is an essential component of all living organisms.
Each component of the machine was tested individually.
Education is a major component of economic development.
The engine contains thousands of small components.

meaningEN: Complete and including almost everything that is necessary.
commonMistakes: ❌ comprehensive about → ✅ comprehensive on / comprehensive report on. ❌ very complete and comprehensive → غالبًا يكفي comprehensive.
examples: The report provides a comprehensive analysis of the data.
Researchers conducted a comprehensive review of previous studies.
The company introduced a comprehensive training program.
We need a comprehensive strategy to solve the problem.
The guide offers comprehensive information for new students.

meaningEN: To give all your attention to something.
commonMistakes: ❌ concentrate in the task → ✅ concentrate on the task. ❌ concentrate at → ✅ concentrate on.
examples: Students should concentrate on understanding concepts rather than memorizing facts.
The government concentrated its efforts on improving healthcare.
Please concentrate while driving.
It is difficult to concentrate in a noisy environment.
Researchers concentrated on the most significant findings.

meaningEN: An abstract idea or general principle.
commonMistakes: ❌ concept about → ✅ concept of. ❌ understand about the concept → ✅ understand the concept.
examples: Students often struggle with abstract concepts.
The concept of sustainability is central to modern environmental policy.
The architect presented a new design concept.
Freedom is a difficult concept to define.
The company introduced an innovative business concept.

meaningEN: A final decision, opinion, or judgment reached after consideration.
commonMistakes: ❌ make a conclusion → ✅ draw/reach a conclusion. ❌ conclusion about → غالبًا conclusion that / conclusion on حسب السياق.
examples: The researchers reached the conclusion that more evidence was needed.
Do not jump to conclusions without sufficient information.
The report concludes with several practical recommendations.
After careful analysis, we came to the same conclusion.
The evidence supports the conclusion that the policy was effective.

meaningEN: To prove that something is true or to state that something is definite.
commonMistakes: ❌ confirm about → ✅ confirm مباشرة دون حرف جر. ❌ confirm for me → ✅ confirm to me / confirm that.
examples: The test results confirmed the doctor's diagnosis.
Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
Scientists confirmed the presence of water in the samples.
The company confirmed the appointment in an email.
Witnesses confirmed that the accident happened at noon.

meaningEN: A result or effect of an action or situation, especially an unpleasant one.
commonMistakes: ❌ consequence for doing → ✅ consequence of doing. ❌ in consequence to → ✅ as a consequence of.
examples: Poor planning can have serious consequences.
He accepted the consequences of his decision.
The new law had unexpected economic consequences.
As a consequence of heavy rain, several roads were closed.
Every action has consequences.

meaningEN: Always behaving or happening in a similar way; in agreement with something.
commonMistakes: ❌ consistent to → ✅ consistent with. ❌ keep consistent → ✅ remain consistent / be consistent.
examples: His explanation is consistent with the available evidence.
The company has maintained consistent growth for five years.
Success requires consistent effort.
The results were consistent across all experiments.
Please be consistent in your evaluation criteria.

meaningEN: Continuing without stopping or changing.
commonMistakes: ❌ constantly change (إذا كان المقصود الشيء ثابت) انتبه للمعنى. ❌ constant with → لا يُستخدم؛ استعمل constant + noun.
examples: The patient requires constant medical supervision.
Technology is undergoing constant change.
She remained under constant pressure throughout the project.
The speed of light is a universal constant.
Constant practice leads to gradual improvement.

meaningEN: To build or make something; an idea or concept formed for a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ construct with bricks → ✅ construct a building with bricks. ❌ construct about → ✅ construct + object مباشرة.
examples: Engineers constructed the bridge in less than two years.
Students were asked to construct a logical argument.
The company plans to construct a new research center.
Children learn to construct meaning from context.
The model was carefully constructed using recycled materials.

meaningEN: The circumstances or background that help explain the meaning of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ context about → ✅ context of. ❌ out from context → ✅ out of context.
examples: The word has a different meaning depending on the context.
His remarks were taken out of context.
Understanding the historical context is essential.
The study should be viewed in a broader context.
Teachers should present vocabulary in context.

meaningEN: A legal agreement between parties; to become smaller or to catch a disease.
commonMistakes: ❌ make a contract → ✅ sign a contract / enter into a contract. ❌ contract with flu → ✅ contract the flu.
examples: Both companies signed a three-year contract.
The business contracted with a local supplier.
He contracted malaria while traveling abroad.
Breaking the contract may result in legal action.
The metal contracts when exposed to cold temperatures.

meaningEN: Following the usual or traditional way of doing something.
commonMistakes: ❌ conventional for → ✅ conventional in / conventional approach. ❌ very traditional and conventional → غالبًا يكفي conventional.
examples: Researchers compared conventional and modern teaching methods.
She prefers conventional medicine to alternative treatments.
The design follows a conventional pattern.
Their views are more conventional than innovative.
Conventional farming often relies on chemical fertilizers.

meaningEN: To work together with others to achieve a shared goal.
commonMistakes: ❌ cooperate together → ✅ cooperate. ❌ cooperate to someone → ✅ cooperate with someone.
examples: The two universities agreed to cooperate on research.
Employees must cooperate with one another.
Several countries cooperated to solve the crisis.
The witness refused to cooperate with investigators.
Success depends on our ability to cooperate effectively.

meaningEN: The standards or principles used to judge or decide something.
commonMistakes: ❌ a criteria → ✅ a criterion / criteria (جمع). ❌ criteria for selecting → ✅ criteria for selection أو criteria for selecting candidates.
examples: Applicants must meet all the selection criteria.
The evaluation criteria were clearly explained.
Price should not be the only criterion for success.
The committee established strict admission criteria.
Researchers used objective criteria to assess quality.

meaningEN: Extremely important because it affects the result of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ very crucial → يُفضّل ✅ crucial لأن معناها يتضمن درجة عالية من الأهمية. ❌ crucial for success → صحيح، وكذلك crucial to success.
examples: Communication plays a crucial role in effective leadership.
It is crucial to verify the data before publishing.
Timing was a crucial factor in the project's success.
The witness provided crucial evidence.
This is a crucial stage in the negotiation process.

meaningEN: Facts or information collected for analysis or reference.
commonMistakes: ❌ datas → ✅ data. ❌ many data is → في الإنجليزية الحديثة data تُعامل غالبًا كمفرد: the data is، وفي الكتابة الأكاديمية قد تُعامل كجمع: the data are.
examples: Researchers collected data from over one thousand participants.
The data suggest that the policy has been effective.
Accurate data are essential for reliable conclusions.
Personal data must be protected.
The report is based on publicly available data.

meaningEN: A formal discussion in which different opinions are expressed.
commonMistakes: ❌ debate about (كفعل) → ✅ debate the issue. كاسم يجوز: a debate about climate change. ❌ discuss about → ✅ discuss.
examples: There is an ongoing debate about artificial intelligence.
Experts debated the long-term effects of the policy.
The proposal sparked a public debate.
Students participated in a classroom debate.
The issue has been widely debated.

meaningEN: To explain the exact meaning or nature of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ define about → ✅ define + object مباشرة. ❌ define as being (غالبًا زائد) → ✅ define as.
examples: The dictionary defines the word precisely.
Success is difficult to define.
The project objectives should be clearly defined.
Scientists continue to define the causes of the disease.
The law clearly defines the responsibilities of employers.

meaningEN: To show clearly by giving proof, evidence, or an example.
commonMistakes: ❌ demonstrate about → ✅ demonstrate + object. ❌ demonstrate someone → ✅ demonstrate something to someone.
examples: The results clearly demonstrate the effectiveness of the treatment.
Applicants must demonstrate strong communication skills.
The experiment demonstrated that the hypothesis was correct.
The teacher demonstrated how to solve the equation.
Employees are expected to demonstrate professionalism at all times.

meaningEN: To obtain or develop something from a particular source.
commonMistakes: ❌ derive by → ✅ derive from. ❌ derive to → ✅ derive something from something.
examples: Many English words derive from Latin.
The company derives most of its income from exports.
Students derive valuable experience from internships.
Scientists derived conclusions from the collected data.
She derives great satisfaction from helping others.

meaningEN: To plan or create something for a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ design for improve → ✅ design to improve / design for improvement. ❌ make a design → ✅ create a design / design something.
examples: Engineers designed the bridge to withstand earthquakes.
The software was designed for beginners.
This study uses a well-designed research method.
She designs educational materials for children.
Good design improves usability and efficiency.

meaningEN: To discover or notice something, especially something difficult to see or recognize.
commonMistakes: ❌ detect about → ✅ detect + object. ❌ detect of → ✅ detect مباشرة.
examples: The test can detect the disease at an early stage.
Scientists detected traces of water in the samples.
Modern software can detect security threats automatically.
It is difficult to detect small changes over time.
The sensor detects movement instantly.

meaningEN: To find out exactly or to decide something officially.
commonMistakes: ❌ determine about → ✅ determine + object. ❌ determine if or not → ✅ determine whether.
examples: Researchers are trying to determine the cause of the disease.
The committee will determine the final outcome.
Age alone does not determine success.
The test determines whether the product is safe.
Further investigation is needed to determine the facts.

meaningEN: To give or deliver something to different people or places.
commonMistakes: ❌ distribute to everyone the books → الأفضل ✅ distribute the books to everyone. ❌ distribute among to → استخدم among أو to حسب السياق وليس كليهما.
examples: The organization distributed food to affected families.
Teachers distributed the exam papers.
Resources should be distributed fairly.
The company distributes its products worldwide.
The profits were distributed among the shareholders.

meaningEN: Related to a country, the home, or family rather than foreign affairs.
commonMistakes: ❌ domestic country → ✅ domestic market / local market. ❌ domestic and local (غالبًا متشابهان حسب السياق).
examples: Domestic demand increased significantly last year.
The airline operates both domestic and international flights.
The government introduced new domestic policies.
Domestic production has reduced imports.
Many companies focus on the domestic market before expanding abroad.

meaningEN: Related to the economy or the production and use of wealth.
commonMistakes: ❌ economical growth → ✅ economic growth. economic = متعلق بالاقتصاد، economical = موفّر.
examples: The country experienced rapid economic growth.
Economic conditions have improved over the past year.
The report examines the economic impact of tourism.
Governments use economic policies to control inflation.
Education contributes to long-term economic development.

meaningEN: Working well without wasting time, effort, or resources.
commonMistakes: ❌ efficient in doing → غالبًا ✅ efficient at doing / efficient in its operation. ❌ very much efficient → ✅ highly efficient.
examples: The new system is more efficient than the old one.
Efficient use of resources reduces costs.
She is an efficient project manager.
Modern engines are more fuel-efficient.
The company adopted more efficient production methods.

meaningEN: A basic or essential part of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ element in success → ✅ element of success. ❌ basic element part → ✅ basic element.
examples: Trust is an essential element of teamwork.
Water is composed of two chemical elements.
The proposal contains several innovative elements.
There is an element of risk in every investment.
Honesty is a key element of good leadership.

meaningEN: To remove or get rid of something completely.
commonMistakes: ❌ eliminate of → ✅ eliminate + object مباشرة. ❌ eliminate from the problem → ✅ eliminate the problem / eliminate something from something.
examples: The new software helps eliminate human error.
Governments are working to eliminate extreme poverty.
Regular testing can eliminate many potential risks.
The company eliminated unnecessary expenses.
These measures eliminate the need for additional paperwork.

meaningEN: Beginning to develop, appear, or become important.
commonMistakes: ❌ emerging country → ✅ emerging economy / emerging market. ❌ emerging from nowhere (إلا إذا كان المقصود حرفيًا).
examples: Artificial intelligence is an emerging technology.
Several emerging markets have experienced rapid growth.
Emerging evidence supports the new treatment.
The company is investing in emerging industries.
Researchers identified several emerging trends.

meaningEN: To give special importance to something.
commonMistakes: ❌ emphasize on → ✅ emphasize + object. يمكن استخدام place emphasis on إذا أردت حرف الجر on.
examples: The teacher emphasized the importance of critical thinking.
Researchers emphasized that more evidence is needed.
The report emphasizes quality over quantity.
Parents should emphasize healthy eating habits.
The speaker emphasized several key points during the presentation.

meaningEN: To make it possible for someone or something to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ enable someone do → ✅ enable someone to do. ❌ enable for → ✅ enable + object.
examples: Technology enables people to work remotely.
The scholarship enabled her to continue her education.
The update enables users to access new features.
These policies enable economic growth.
Good leadership enables employees to perform at their best.

meaningEN: To experience or meet something unexpectedly.
commonMistakes: ❌ encounter with problems (كفعل) → ✅ encounter problems. أما الاسم: an encounter with...
examples: Many students encounter difficulties in their first year at university.
Scientists encountered unexpected results during the experiment.
Travelers may encounter delays due to bad weather.
The team encountered strong competition.
It was my first encounter with machine learning.

meaningEN: Equal in value, amount, meaning, or importance.
commonMistakes: ❌ equivalent with → ✅ equivalent to. ❌ equal equivalent → يكفي equivalent أو equal.
examples: A bachelor's degree is roughly equivalent to this qualification.
There is no exact equivalent in Arabic.
The two methods are functionally equivalent.
One euro is not equivalent to one dollar.
Experience may be considered equivalent to formal education.

meaningEN: To carefully judge the quality, value, or importance of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ evaluate about → ✅ evaluate + object مباشرة. ❌ evaluate of → لا تُستخدم.
examples: Teachers evaluate students throughout the semester.
The committee evaluated all the proposals carefully.
Scientists evaluated the effectiveness of the vaccine.
It is important to evaluate the available evidence objectively.
Customers are encouraged to evaluate the service.

meaningEN: To develop gradually over time into a more advanced form.
commonMistakes: ❌ evolve to → ✅ evolve into. ❌ evolve by time → ✅ evolve over time.
examples: Languages evolve over time.
The company evolved into a global organization.
Technology continues to evolve rapidly.
The discussion evolved into a heated debate.
Species evolve through natural selection.

meaningEN: To become larger or increase in size, number, or importance.
commonMistakes: ❌ expand to new markets → ✅ expand into new markets. ❌ expand of → ✅ expand + object أو expand into.
examples: The company plans to expand into Asian markets.
Reading helps expand your vocabulary.
The university expanded its research facilities.
Businesses must expand to remain competitive.
The metal expands when heated.

meaningEN: A person with a high level of knowledge or skill in a particular field.
commonMistakes: ❌ expert of → ✅ expert in / expert on. expert in = مجال المهارة، expert on = موضوع معين.
examples: She is an expert in cybersecurity.
We consulted several experts before making a decision.
He is an expert on ancient Egyptian history.
Expert advice can save both time and money.
The witness was recognized as an expert in forensic science.

meaningEN: A fact, situation, or influence that affects the result of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ factor for success → ✅ factor in success / factor contributing to success. ❌ factor of → يعتمد على السياق، والأكثر شيوعًا factor in.
examples: Education is a key factor in economic development.
Cost was the deciding factor in our final decision.
Several environmental factors affect crop production.
Age is an important factor when assessing health risks.
We must factor in inflation when planning the budget.

meaningEN: An important part or characteristic of something; to include as a special part.
commonMistakes: ❌ feature of product → ✅ feature of the product. ❌ feature on (كفعل) → ✅ feature in / feature someone or something.
examples: Safety is a key feature of the new vehicle.
The magazine features interviews with leading scientists.
This software includes several advanced features.
The report featured examples from different countries.
One distinctive feature of the building is its glass roof.

meaningEN: Last in a series or process; the last examination or competition.
commonMistakes: ❌ at the final → ✅ in the final (للمنافسات) أو at the final stage. ❌ final conclusion → يُفضل conclusion وحدها إذا لم تكن المقارنة مطلوبة.
examples: The committee reached its final decision yesterday.
Please submit the final version by Friday.
The team advanced to the final.
This is the final stage of the project.
The final results will be announced tomorrow.

meaningEN: The management of money; to provide money for something.
commonMistakes: ❌ finance for a project → ✅ finance a project / provide finance for a project. ❌ finances are good = يمكن، لكن finances تشير إلى الوضع المالي الشخصي أو المؤسسي.
examples: The government will finance the construction of the new hospital.
She works in corporate finance.
Poor financial planning can lead to serious problems.
The project is financed by private investors.
Students often study finance alongside economics.

meaningEN: The center of attention or interest; to give special attention to something.
commonMistakes: ❌ focus in → ✅ focus on. ❌ focus about → ✅ focus on.
examples: The discussion focused on environmental issues.
Students should focus on understanding rather than memorizing.
The company's main focus is customer satisfaction.
The camera automatically focuses on moving objects.
We need to focus our efforts on long-term goals.

meaningEN: The purpose of something; to operate or work properly.
commonMistakes: ❌ function of doing → ✅ function of something. ❌ function like → يمكن، لكن function as أكثر دقة عند بيان الدور.
examples: The primary function of the heart is to pump blood.
The system continues to function normally.
This device functions as both a scanner and a printer.
Every department has a specific function.
Brain function declines with age in some individuals.

meaningEN: To produce or create something.
commonMistakes: ❌ generate to → ✅ generate + object مباشرة. ❌ make generation → ✅ generate.
examples: The business generates millions of dollars each year.
Wind turbines generate electricity.
The campaign generated significant public interest.
Researchers generated new data using advanced software.
The discussion generated several useful ideas.

meaningEN: To recognize or establish who or what someone or something is.
commonMistakes: ❌ identify about → ✅ identify + object. ❌ identify to → ✅ identify with (يتعاطف) أو identify as (يعرّف نفسه بأنه).
examples: Scientists identified the source of the infection.
The report identifies several areas for improvement.
It is important to identify potential risks early.
Witnesses identified the suspect.
Students should identify the main idea of each paragraph.

meaningEN: To explain or make something clear by using examples, diagrams, or evidence.
commonMistakes: ❌ illustrate about → ✅ illustrate + object. ❌ explain by illustration → غالبًا يكفي illustrate.
examples: The graph illustrates the relationship between income and education.
The lecturer used real-life examples to illustrate the concept.
These findings illustrate the importance of early intervention.
The report illustrates how technology influences productivity.
The diagram clearly illustrates the production process.

meaningEN: A strong effect or influence on someone or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ impact to → ✅ impact on (كاسم). كفعل: The policy impacted the economy. ❌ big impact → يفضل significant/major impact في الكتابة الأكاديمية.
examples: Climate change has a significant impact on agriculture.
The new policy positively impacted small businesses.
Researchers examined the long-term impact of air pollution.
Technology has had a profound impact on education.
The report assesses the environmental impact of the project.

meaningEN: To put a plan, decision, or system into effect.
commonMistakes: ❌ implement of → ✅ implement + object مباشرة. ❌ implement into practice → ✅ implement / put into practice.
examples: The government implemented new environmental regulations.
The company successfully implemented a digital transformation strategy.
Schools are implementing updated teaching methods.
The recommendations should be implemented immediately.
Effective leaders know how to implement change.

meaningEN: A possible effect, consequence, or meaning that is not directly stated.
commonMistakes: ❌ implication to → ✅ implication for. ❌ implication about → ✅ implication of / implication for حسب المعنى.
examples: The study has important implications for public health.
Researchers discussed the economic implications of the policy.
His statement carried serious legal implications.
We must consider the long-term implications of our decisions.
The findings have broader implications for future research.

meaningEN: To show, point out, or suggest that something is true.
commonMistakes: ❌ indicate about → ✅ indicate that / indicate + object. ❌ indicate to that → ✅ indicate that.
examples: The results indicate that the treatment is effective.
Recent data indicate a steady increase in demand.
Dark clouds indicate that rain is likely.
The survey indicates a high level of customer satisfaction.
The findings indicate the need for further research.

meaningEN: A single person; relating to one person rather than a group.
commonMistakes: ❌ individual person → ✅ individual. ❌ each individuals → ✅ each individual.
examples: Each individual has unique strengths.
Teachers should consider individual learning styles.
The program is tailored to individual needs.
Individual responsibility is essential for teamwork.
Researchers interviewed each individual separately.

meaningEN: To explain the meaning of something or understand it in a particular way.
commonMistakes: ❌ interpret about → ✅ interpret + object. ❌ interpret as meaning that (غالبًا مطول) → ✅ interpret as.
examples: Scientists interpreted the results with caution.
Different cultures may interpret the same gesture differently.
It is important to interpret the data accurately.
The law can be interpreted in several ways.
Students learned how to interpret graphs.

meaningEN: To include someone or something as a necessary part.
commonMistakes: ❌ involve to do → ✅ involve doing. ❌ involve with → ✅ involve someone in something.
examples: The project involves collaboration between several universities.
Learning a language involves regular practice.
Parents should be involved in their children's education.
The job involves frequent travel.
The procedure involves several stages.

meaningEN: An important topic or problem for discussion or decision.
commonMistakes: ❌ discuss about an issue → ✅ discuss an issue. ❌ issue regarding about → ✅ issue regarding.
examples: Climate change is a major global issue.
The meeting addressed several important issues.
We need to resolve this issue as soon as possible.
The report raises concerns about environmental issues.
Housing remains a significant social issue.

meaningEN: Work, especially physical work, or the workers collectively (UK spelling).
commonMistakes: ❌ labours (للدلالة على القوى العاملة) → ✅ labour. انتبه: الأمريكية تكتب labor.
examples: The labour market has become increasingly competitive.
Many industries face a shortage of skilled labour.
Labour costs have risen significantly.
The government introduced reforms to the labour market.
Improving labour productivity is a national priority.

meaningEN: Related to the law or allowed by law.
commonMistakes: ❌ legal for → ✅ legal to do / legal requirement. ❌ law issues → ✅ legal issues.
examples: The company sought legal advice before signing the contract.
Smoking is legal in some countries but restricted in others.
Employers have legal responsibilities toward their staff.
The dispute was resolved through legal action.
The report examines the legal framework for data protection.

meaningEN: A particular way of doing something.
commonMistakes: ❌ method for doing → ✅ method of doing (الأكثر شيوعًا) أو method for + noun. ❌ way method → اختر أحدهما فقط.
examples: Researchers used a reliable method to collect the data.
The scientific method is fundamental to modern research.
This teaching method improves student engagement.
We need a more effective method of communication.
Several different methods were compared in the study.

meaningEN: To happen or exist.
commonMistakes: ❌ occur to a place → ✅ occur in a place. انتبه: occur to someone = تخطر ببال شخص.
examples: The error occurred during data processing.
Earthquakes frequently occur in this region.
Several unexpected problems occurred during the experiment.
The disease occurs naturally in tropical climates.
The meeting occurred earlier than scheduled.

meaningEN: To take part in an activity or event.
commonMistakes: ❌ participate to → ✅ participate in.
examples: More than 500 students participated in the survey.
Employees are encouraged to participate in training programs.
Everyone should participate actively in the discussion.
Many countries participated in the conference.
She decided to participate in the competition.

meaningEN: A plan or set of rules adopted by an organization or government.
commonMistakes: ❌ policy about → ✅ policy on.
examples: The government introduced a new education policy.
Company policy requires all employees to attend training.
The report recommends changes to public policy.
Environmental policy has become a national priority.
The policy was implemented successfully.

meaningEN: A fundamental rule, belief, or truth.
commonMistakes: ❌ principal (مدير/رئيس) بدل principle. ❌ principle for → ✅ principle of.
examples: Honesty is one of her guiding principles.
The principle of equality is protected by law.
Scientists rely on established scientific principles.
This machine operates on a simple principle.
The proposal is sound in principle.

meaningEN: A series of actions taken to achieve a result.
commonMistakes: ❌ process of to do → ✅ process of doing.
examples: Learning a language is a gradual process.
The computer processes data very quickly.
The hiring process takes several weeks.
Researchers improved the manufacturing process.
Recovery is often a slow process.

meaningEN: To reply or react to something.
commonMistakes: ❌ respond on → ✅ respond to.
examples: The company responded quickly to customer complaints.
Patients responded well to the treatment.
Governments must respond to climate change.
She responded politely to the email.
Emergency services responded within minutes.

meaningEN: Something useful that can be used to achieve a goal.
commonMistakes: ❌ resourceses → ✅ resources. ❌ resource for money → ✅ financial resources.
examples: Water is one of our most valuable natural resources.
The company invested heavily in human resources.
Schools need more educational resources.
Resources should be allocated efficiently.
Limited resources require careful planning.

meaningEN: A distinct part of an economy or society.
commonMistakes: ❌ sector of economy → ✅ sector of the economy.
examples: The private sector created thousands of new jobs.
Investment in the health sector has increased.
The tourism sector plays a vital role in the economy.
Several sectors were affected by the recession.
Technology is transforming every sector.

meaningEN: A detailed plan designed to achieve a long-term goal.
commonMistakes: ❌ strategy for to improve → ✅ strategy for improving.
examples: The company developed a long-term growth strategy.
Effective learning strategies improve academic performance.
The government announced a new economic strategy.
A clear strategy is essential for success.
Researchers proposed several strategies for reducing pollution.

meaningEN: To maintain, support, or continue something over a long period.
commonMistakes: ❌ sustain to do → ✅ sustain + object. ❌ sustainable growth ≠ sustained growth (الأولى قابل للاستمرار، والثانية مستمر).
examples: The country must sustain economic growth over the next decade.
Regular practice helps sustain language skills.
The bridge sustained only minor damage during the earthquake.
Renewable energy supports sustainable development.
The organization sustained its success through innovation.

meaningEN: To regard something as being caused by someone or something; a quality or characteristic of someone or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ attribute with → ✅ attribute A to B. ❌ because of instead of attribute to في الكتابة الأكاديمية عندما تريد بيان السبب الرسمي.
examples: Researchers attributed the decline in emissions to stricter environmental policies.
Many people attribute her success to years of consistent practice.
Patience is an essential attribute of an effective leader.
The report attributes the increase in costs to inflation.
Honesty is widely regarded as a defining attribute of good leadership.

meaningEN: The maximum amount that something can contain or produce; the ability to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ capacity to doing → ✅ capacity to do / capacity for doing. ❌ capability and capacity ليستا مترادفتين دائمًا؛ capacity غالبًا تعني السعة أو القدرة الكمية.
examples: The factory is operating at full capacity.
The human brain has an extraordinary capacity for learning.
The airport plans to increase passenger capacity.
Teachers should develop students' capacity for critical thinking.
The hospital exceeded its emergency capacity during the crisis.

meaningEN: Logical, well-organized, and easy to understand.
commonMistakes: ❌ coherent with → غالبًا ✅ coherent argument / coherent with previous findings حسب السياق. ❌ coherence sentence → ✅ coherent sentence.
examples: The essay presents a coherent argument supported by evidence.
Her explanation was clear and coherent.
The committee developed a coherent long-term strategy.
A coherent paragraph should focus on one main idea.
The report provides a coherent analysis of the available evidence.

meaningEN: To collect information from different sources and arrange it into one document or list.
commonMistakes: ❌ compile from many sources → الأفضل ✅ compile information from many sources. ❌ collect و compile ليسا دائمًا متطابقين؛ compile يتضمن التنظيم أيضًا.
examples: Researchers compiled data from more than fifty published studies.
The editor compiled the articles into a single volume.
The report was compiled using official government statistics.
Students compiled a list of reliable academic sources.
The database was compiled over several years.

meaningEN: To consist of or be made up of; to include.
commonMistakes: ❌ comprise of → ✅ comprise. مثال: The committee comprises ten members. ويُقبل أيضًا: is comprised of في الإنجليزية الحديثة، لكن الأكاديمية تفضّل comprise.
examples: The committee comprises representatives from five countries.
The course comprises six compulsory modules.
The collection comprises over two thousand manuscripts.
Women comprise nearly half of the workforce.
The examination comprises both written and oral sections.
wordFamily: composition (n. ليس مشتقًا مباشرًا في المعنى)

meaningEN: To limit someone's actions or restrict the development of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ constrain from → ✅ constrain someone/something or be constrained by. ❌ constraint و restraint يختلفان في الاستعمال.
examples: Limited funding constrained the scope of the project.
Many small businesses are constrained by rising costs.
Time constraints affected the quality of the research.
Environmental regulations constrain industrial emissions.
The team felt constrained by the tight deadline.

meaningEN: Public disagreement or debate about an issue that many people have strong opinions about.
commonMistakes: ❌ controversy about whether → غالبًا ✅ controversy over. ❌ discuss about the controversy → ✅ discuss the controversy.
examples: The proposal sparked widespread controversy.
There is ongoing controversy over the use of artificial intelligence in education.
The decision generated considerable public controversy.
Scientists attempted to avoid political controversy.
The issue remains a source of controversy.

meaningEN: To change something from one form, purpose, or system into another.
commonMistakes: ❌ convert in → ✅ convert into / convert to حسب السياق. convert A into B = يحول A إلى B.
examples: Solar panels convert sunlight into electricity.
The document was converted to PDF format.
The warehouse was converted into a museum.
Researchers converted the measurements into standard units.
Many countries are converting to renewable energy sources.

meaningEN: A standard used for judging or making a decision.
commonMistakes: ❌ a criteria → ✅ a criterion. criteria هو الجمع.
examples: Cost was the main criterion for selecting the supplier.
Each application was evaluated against the same criterion.
Reliability is an important criterion for scientific research.
The scholarship has a strict eligibility criterion.
Accuracy should be the primary assessment criterion.

meaningEN: To depart from an accepted standard, plan, or course.
commonMistakes: ❌ deviate to → ✅ deviate from. ❌ deviate the plan → ✅ deviate from the plan.
examples: Drivers should not deviate from the designated route.
The results did not deviate significantly from previous studies.
The company refused to deviate from its original strategy.
The measurements deviated slightly from the expected values.
Researchers explained the reasons for the deviation.

meaningEN: A particular aspect, feature, or measurable size of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ dimension about → ✅ dimension of. ❌ size dimension → يكفي dimension.
examples: The report examines the social dimension of climate change.
Technology has added a new dimension to education.
The economic dimension of the problem cannot be ignored.
The project has both local and global dimensions.
Researchers analyzed every dimension of the issue.

meaningEN: To become or make something smaller, weaker, or less important.
commonMistakes: ❌ diminish from → ✅ diminish + object أو diminish over time.
examples: Public confidence diminished after the incident.
The effects gradually diminished over time.
Nothing can diminish her achievements.
The policy helped diminish income inequality.
Exercise does not diminish with age if maintained regularly.

meaningEN: Separate and distinct from other things.
commonMistakes: ❌ discrete = discreet ❌. discrete = منفصل، discreet = متحفظ.
examples: The study examined three discrete groups.
The process consists of several discrete stages.
Each component functions as a discrete unit.
The data were divided into discrete categories.
The variables should be treated as discrete values.

meaningEN: Characterized by constant change, activity, or progress.
commonMistakes: ❌ dynamicly → ✅ dynamically.
examples: Technology creates a dynamic learning environment.
The market is highly dynamic and competitive.
Leadership requires a dynamic approach to problem-solving.
The relationship between supply and demand is dynamic.
The company operates in a dynamic global market.

meaningEN: The system by which goods and services are produced and used.
commonMistakes: ❌ economical = موفر، economy = اقتصاد.
examples: The national economy grew steadily last year.
Tourism contributes significantly to the local economy.
The digital economy is expanding rapidly.
Inflation affects every sector of the economy.
Governments introduced measures to strengthen the economy.

meaningEN: To create, prove, or start something permanently.
commonMistakes: ❌ establish about → ✅ establish + object.
examples: The university established a new research center.
Scientists established a link between diet and health.
The organization was established in 1995.
It is important to establish clear objectives.
The evidence established his innocence.

meaningEN: To roughly calculate or judge the value, number, or cost of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ estimate about → ✅ estimate + object.
examples: Experts estimated the damage at two million dollars.
It is difficult to estimate future demand accurately.
The project cost exceeded the original estimate.
Researchers estimated the population size.
The journey is estimated to take three hours.

meaningEN: To be greater than a limit, amount, or expectation.
commonMistakes: ❌ exceed than → ✅ exceed مباشرة دون than.
examples: Demand exceeded supply during the summer.
The results exceeded our expectations.
The vehicle exceeded the speed limit.
Costs exceeded the original budget.
Student performance exceeded previous records.

meaningEN: To intentionally leave out or prevent someone or something from being included.
commonMistakes: ❌ exclude to → ✅ exclude from.
examples: Children under five were excluded from the study.
The report excludes confidential information.
We cannot exclude the possibility of failure.
Several applicants were excluded from the competition.
The analysis excluded incomplete responses.

meaningEN: To show or display a quality, behavior, or object.
commonMistakes: ❌ exhibit about → ✅ exhibit + object.
examples: Patients may exhibit mild symptoms.
The museum exhibited ancient artifacts.
Successful leaders exhibit resilience.
The company exhibited its latest products.
The child exhibited exceptional talent.

meaningEN: To make a process easier or more efficient.
commonMistakes: ❌ facilitate to do → ✅ facilitate + noun.
examples: Technology facilitates communication across borders.
The program facilitates access to higher education.
The moderator facilitated the discussion effectively.
These reforms will facilitate economic growth.
Good planning facilitates efficient project management.

meaningEN: A basic structure or system that supports something.
commonMistakes: ❌ framework of doing → ✅ framework for doing.
examples: The policy provides a clear legal framework.
Researchers developed a conceptual framework for the study.
The framework supports long-term planning.
A strong regulatory framework encourages investment.
The report proposes a new analytical framework.

meaningEN: Forming the base or most important part of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ very fundamental → يكفي fundamental.
examples: Education is fundamental to social development.
Trust is a fundamental element of teamwork.
The proposal requires fundamental changes.
Freedom of speech is a fundamental right.
Understanding statistics is fundamental for researchers.

meaningEN: A system in which people or things are arranged according to importance.
commonMistakes: ❌ hierarchy between → ✅ hierarchy within/of.
examples: The company has a clear organizational hierarchy.
Authority is distributed throughout the hierarchy.
The military operates within a strict hierarchy.
Researchers examined the social hierarchy of the group.
The hierarchy influences decision-making.

meaningEN: A proposed explanation that can be tested through research.
commonMistakes: ❌ hypothesises → ✅ hypotheses (plural).
examples: The experiment supported the original hypothesis.
Scientists tested several competing hypotheses.
A strong hypothesis should be measurable.
The evidence failed to support the hypothesis.
Students learned how to formulate a research hypothesis.

meaningEN: Something that encourages a person to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ incentive of → ✅ incentive for / incentive to.
examples: Financial incentives encouraged companies to reduce emissions.
The government introduced tax incentives for investors.
Employees need incentives to improve productivity.
Higher salaries can provide an incentive to stay.
The scheme offers incentives for innovation.

meaningEN: To include something as part of a whole.
commonMistakes: ❌ incorporate with → ✅ incorporate into.
examples: The revised report incorporates reviewers' comments.
Teachers should incorporate technology into lessons.
The design incorporates environmentally friendly materials.
Researchers incorporated additional variables into the analysis.
The company incorporated customer feedback into the product.

meaningEN: Certain to happen and impossible to avoid.
commonMistakes: ❌ inevitable to happen → ✅ inevitable.
examples: Technological change is inevitable.
Some mistakes are inevitable during the learning process.
The economic slowdown was considered inevitable.
Conflict became inevitable after the negotiations failed.
Urban expansion seems inevitable in rapidly growing cities.

meaningEN: The basic systems and facilities needed for a country or organization to function.
commonMistakes: ❌ infrastructures (في الغالب غير معدودة) → ✅ infrastructure.
examples: The government invested heavily in transport infrastructure.
Reliable digital infrastructure supports economic growth.
Poor infrastructure limits industrial development.
Infrastructure projects create thousands of jobs.
Modern infrastructure attracts foreign investment.

meaningEN: To introduce new ideas, methods, or products.
commonMistakes: ❌ innovate something new → ✅ innovate / develop something new.
examples: Companies must innovate to remain competitive.
The organization continues to innovate in healthcare.
Small businesses often innovate more quickly than large corporations.
Researchers are innovating through artificial intelligence.
Innovation helps economies grow sustainably.

meaningEN: To combine separate parts so that they work together.
commonMistakes: ❌ integrate to → ✅ integrate into / integrate with.
examples: The school integrates technology into every classroom.
New employees quickly integrated into the team.
The software integrates with existing systems.
Countries are working to integrate renewable energy into the power grid.
Successful education integrates theory with practice.

meaningEN: Existing or happening inside an organization, body, or system.
commonMistakes: ❌ internal inside → تكرار غير ضروري.
examples: The company conducted an internal investigation.
Internal communication is essential for teamwork.
The disease caused internal bleeding.
Researchers examined the internal structure of the material.
The organization improved its internal processes.

meaningEN: An explanation or understanding of the meaning of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ interpretation about → ✅ interpretation of.
examples: The results allow several possible interpretations.
Accurate interpretation of data is essential.
The court adopted a strict interpretation of the law.
Different cultures may have different interpretations of the same symbol.
His interpretation of the findings was widely accepted.

meaningEN: To show that something is reasonable, necessary, or correct.
commonMistakes: ❌ justify for → ✅ justify + object.
examples: The evidence was insufficient to justify the conclusion.
Can the benefits justify the additional expense?
Researchers must justify their methodology.
The company could not justify the price increase.
His actions were difficult to justify.

meaningEN: A system or process by which something works or is achieved.
commonMistakes: ❌ mechanism to do → ✅ mechanism for doing.
examples: Scientists investigated the mechanism responsible for memory formation.
The agreement includes a mechanism for resolving disputes.
Feedback is an important mechanism for improvement.
Researchers proposed a new mechanism to explain the results.
The body's immune mechanism protects against disease.

The article condemns the exploitation of workers.

meaningEN: To keep something within limits; to restrict.
commonMistakes: ❌ confine to doing ✓ → ✅ be confined to + place؛ confine oneself to + فعل.
examples: The fire was confined to the kitchen.
Please confine your questions to the topic.
He was confined to bed for a week.
The damage was confined to one department.

meaningEN: To follow rules or accepted behaviour.
commonMistakes: ❌ conform vs adapt → ✅ conform = امتثال للقواعد؛ adapt = تكيف.
examples: The product must conform to safety standards.
Students are expected to conform to the dress code.
She refuses to conform to outdated expectations.
The design conforms with the original plan.

meaningEN: To face someone or something bravely.
commonMistakes: ❌ confront vs face → ✅ confront قد يعني المواجهة المباشرة مع شخص؛ face أكثر عمومية.
examples: We must confront the problem calmly.
She finally confronted her fear of speaking.
The team was confronted with a difficult decision.
Managers should confront underperformance directly.

meaningEN: To protect and avoid wasting something.
commonMistakes: ❌ conserve vs preserve → ✅ conserve = ترشيد/حماية من النفاد؛ preserve = حفظ الوضع كما هو.
examples: Turning off lights helps conserve energy.
Farmers are urged to conserve water.
The park exists to conserve rare species.

meaningEN: To defeat someone or something; to overcome.

The brand quickly conquered the local market.
The army conquered the city in three days.
Patience helped him conquer the difficult task.

meaningEN: Modern; from the same time period.
commonMistakes: ❌ contemporary vs modern → ✅ contemporary = معاصر/من نفس العصر؛ modern = حديث.

Contemporary society relies heavily on technology.
The playwright's contemporaries admired his work.
We studied contemporary debates on energy.

meaningEN: To say the opposite of what someone said.

He contradicted the witness's account.
Avoid statements that contradict the graph.
The two reports directly contradicted each other.

meaningEN: To have a relationship or connection with something.

examples: Sleep quality correlates with exam performance.
The study found the two factors closely correlated.
Income correlates positively with education.
Do not assume every correlation shows a cause.

meaningEN: To communicate ideas or feelings; to transport.
commonMistakes: ❌ convey to someone ✓ → ✅ convey + object + to + الشخص.
examples: The chart conveys the trend clearly.
Words fail to convey the scale of the disaster.
Please convey my thanks to the team.
Body language conveys more than speech.

meaningEN: To control or limit something.
commonMistakes: ❌ curb vs limit → ✅ curb = كبح تدريجي؛ limit = حد لا تتجاوزه.
examples: The government moved to curb inflation.
New rules curb excessive noise at night.
Raising taxes helped curb tobacco use.
The city curbed the growth of traffic.

meaningEN: To organise the parts of an activity to work together.
commonMistakes: ❌ coordinate vs cooperate → ✅ coordinate = تنسيق/تنظيم؛ cooperate = تعاون.
examples: She coordinated the volunteers for the event.
Emergency services coordinated their response.
The plan failed because nobody coordinated the steps.
Teams from three cities coordinated the research.

meaningEN: Able to be believed or trusted.
commonMistakes: ❌ credible vs credulous → ✅ credible = جدير بالتصديق؛ credulous = سريع التصديق.
examples: Journalists rely on credible sources.
The threat was serious and credible.
Only credible evidence was considered.
The story seemed too strange to be credible.

meaningEN: To take someone's attention away from something.
commonMistakes: ❌ distract vs detract → ✅ distract = يشتت؛ detract (from) = ينتقص من.
examples: Phones can distract students during class.
Background noise distracted her from the task.
The headline distracted readers from the facts.
Try not to let small problems distract you.

meaningEN: To discourage someone from doing something.
commonMistakes: ❌ deter someone from doing ✓ → ✅ لا تستخدم deter to do.
examples: High prices deter many potential buyers.
Cameras deter theft in shops.
The cold weather did not deter the runners.
Risks, like penalties, deter dishonest behaviour.

meaningEN: To make pain or a problem less severe.
commonMistakes: ❌ alleviate vs eliminate → ✅ alleviate = تخفيف؛ eliminate = إزالة كاملة.
examples: Warm baths can alleviate muscle pain.
The aid programme aims to alleviate rural poverty.
Flexible hours helped alleviate stress at work.
Trees alleviate the heat in the city.

meaningEN: Having more than one possible meaning; unclear.

Ambiguous instructions cause mixed results.
His answer remained ambiguous to the end.
The graph was too ambiguous to read.

meaningEN: Having mixed feelings about something.
commonMistakes: ❌ ambivalent about + شيء ✓ → ✅ ambivalent (له مشاعر متضاربة) وليس 'غير مبالٍ'.
examples: She felt ambivalent about moving abroad.
The public is ambivalent about the new policy.
He gave an ambivalent answer to the question.
Our feelings about technology are often ambivalent.

meaningEN: Something unusual or different from what is expected.
commonMistakes: ❌ anomaly (جمع anomalies) → ✅ clearly/rare anomaly.
examples: The result was a clear statistical anomaly.
Engineers detected an anomaly in the data.
One warm month is an anomaly, not a trend.
The pattern showed no unusual anomalies.

meaningEN: The state of being united and working well together.
commonMistakes: ❌ cohesion (n.) vs cohesive (adj.) → ✅ انتبه للإملاء.
examples: Shared values strengthen social cohesion.
Team cohesion improved after the training.
The essay needs more cohesion between paragraphs.
Public events can promote cohesion in a community.

meaningEN: Clear and convincing.
commonMistakes: ❌ cogent vs coherent → ✅ cogent = مقنع؛ coherent = متماسك.
examples: She presented a cogent argument for reform.
There is no cogent reason to delay.
The lawyer built a cogent case.
The essay was clear, logical, and cogent.

meaningEN: To collect and arrange information in order.
commonMistakes: ❌ collate vs collect → ✅ collate = جمع مع تنظيم وترتيب منهجي.
examples: The office collated the survey responses.
Researchers collated data from three studies.
Please collate the pages before binding.
The report was collated from many sources.

meaningEN: To begin something.
commonMistakes: ❌ commence vs begin/start → ✅ commence الرسمية؛ شائعة في العقود والتقارير.
examples: Construction will commence next month.
The ceremony commences with a short speech.
Research commenced at the start of the year.
The trial commenced after a long delay.

meaningEN: Short and clear, without unnecessary words.
commonMistakes: ❌ concise vs short → ✅ concise = قصير ومكتمل وواضح في آنٍ واحد.
examples: Give a concise summary of the main idea.
The answers should be clear and concise.
Her writing is informative without being wordy.
Keep the email concise and friendly.

meaningEN: Making something likely or easier to happen.

examples: Quiet spaces are conducive to concentration.
The schedule is conducive to deep study blocks.
A trusting culture is conducive to innovation.
Fresh air makes the room conducive to work.

meaningEN: Disagreement; a claim made in an argument.
commonMistakes: ❌ contention vs contention with خلاف → ✅ bone of contention = نقطة خلاف.
examples: His main contention is that costs are too high.
The budget became a bone of contention.
The two parties are in contention over the land.
The evidence supports that contention.

meaningEN: Depending on something that may happen; a group of people.
commonMistakes: ❌ contingent on + شيء ✓ → ✅ be contingent on/upon.
examples: Financial aid is contingent on academic progress.
Their participation is contingent on the weather.
The plan included a contingent emergency team.
A contingent of athletes arrived early.

meaningEN: To support a claim with evidence.
commonMistakes: ❌ corroborate vs confirm → ✅ corroborate = تدعيم بشهادة/دليل آخر.
examples: Two witnesses corroborated the story.
Independent data corroborate the findings.

Police sought evidence to corroborate the account.

meaningEN: Belief that something is true.
commonMistakes: ❌ credence (n.) شائعة مع give/lend credence to.

New data lend credence to the theory.
The photo adds credence to her account.
The rumour gained credence quickly.

meaningEN: Increasing gradually by adding more.
commonMistakes: ❌ cumulative vs accumulative → ✅ cumulative (أشيع)؛ accumulative أقل استخداماً.

The cumulative total reached one million.
Noise pollution has a cumulative impact on sleep.
The line shows cumulative sales over the year.

meaningEN: Seeming difficult or frightening to deal with.
commonMistakes: ❌ daunting (adj.) vs daunt (v.) → ✅ seem daunting = يبدو شاقاً.
examples: Writing the essay seemed a daunting task.
Moving abroad is a daunting prospect.
The list of requirements looked daunting at first.
Breaking the task into steps made it less daunting.

meaningEN: Open to argument; not certain to be true.
commonMistakes: ❌ debatable (adj.) → ✅ it is debatable whether ...
examples: Whether the policy works is debatable.
The claim remains a debatable point.
Its benefits are highly debatable.
This argument rests on a debatable assumption.

meaningEN: To work out the meaning of something difficult to read.
commonMistakes: ❌ decipher vs decode → ✅ متقاربان؛ decipher = حل الغموض غالباً.
examples: Historians deciphered the ancient script.
Her handwriting was hard to decipher.
Analysts tried to decipher the coded signal.
The chart helps decipher the pattern.

meaningEN: To consider or judge something in a formal way.
commonMistakes: ❌ deem + object + صفة/اسم → ✅ deem it necessary to do.
examples: The project was deemed a success.
Only valid tickets are deemed acceptable.
The rule was deemed necessary for safety.
The court deemed the evidence unreliable.

meaningEN: Not having enough of something; inadequate.
commonMistakes: ❌ deficient in + شيء ✓ → ✅ deficiency (n.); deficient ≠ deficit (مالي).
examples: The diet was deficient in iron.
Training was deficient in several areas.
The soil is deficient in essential minerals.
The report found the safety checks deficient.

meaningEN: To see or understand the difference between things.
commonMistakes: ❌ distinguish between A and B / distinguish A from B → ✅.
examples: Babies soon learn to distinguish voices.
The report fails to distinguish between fact and opinion.
Good design distinguishes one brand from another.

meaningEN: To throw something away because it is useless or unwanted.
commonMistakes: ❌ discard vs dispose of → ✅ متقاربان؛ discard = رمي/استبعاد؛ dispose of أكثر رسمية.
examples: Please discard any outdated records.
They discarded the plan after the trial.
Outdated equipment was discarded.
The theory was discarded for lack of evidence.

meaningEN: To make something known publicly.
commonMistakes: ❌ disclose vs reveal → ✅ متقاربان؛ disclose = إفصاح عن معلومات رسمية/سرية.
examples: The bank did not disclose the figures.
Candidates must disclose any previous offence.
Companies disclose risks in their reports.
The findings were disclosed at the press conference.

meaningEN: To treat people unfairly because of their group; to distinguish.
commonMistakes: ❌ discriminate between/against → ✅ ضد = against؛ بين = between.
examples: It is illegal to discriminate on the basis of gender.
The law protects workers from being discriminated against.
Computers can discriminate between similar shapes.
Affordable housing removes barriers, not discrimination.

meaningEN: To force people or things to move from their place.
commonMistakes: ❌ displace vs replace → ✅ displace = يزيح من المكان؛ replace = يستبدل بـ.

Automation may displace some manual jobs.
The flood displaced the whole village.
New parts displaced older ones in the design.

meaningEN: A disagreement or argument; to question whether something is true.

The ownership of the land was in dispute.
Few experts dispute the findings.
A wage dispute stopped production for a week.

commonMistakes: ❌ distort vs disturb → ✅ distort = تشويه؛ disturb = إزعاج.

Heat can distort plastic surfaces.
Advertising sometimes distorts consumer choices.
The numbers were distorted by seasonal effects.

meaningEN: Very different from each other; including many kinds.
commonMistakes: ❌ diverse vs various → ✅ diverse = متنوع ومختلف؛ various = مختلف أنواع.
examples: The city has a culturally diverse population.
Students come from diverse social backgrounds.
The course covers a diverse range of topics.
A diverse team produces better ideas.

meaningEN: Most important or powerful; controlling.
commonMistakes: ❌ dominant vs predominant → ✅ متقاربان؛ dominant = مسيطر أقوى؛ predominant = الأكثر شيوعاً.
examples: English has a dominant role in academia.
The firm holds a dominant market position.
Two dominant parties shape the debate.
Recycling is becoming the dominant method of disposal.

meaningEN: To interrupt something and stop it from continuing normally.
commonMistakes: ❌ disrupt vs interrupt → ✅ disrupt = تعطيل واسع؛ interrupt = مقاطعة لحظية.
examples: Strikes disrupted rail services for days.
New apps aim to disrupt the taxi industry.
The storm disrupted power supply overnight.
Constant noise disrupts concentration.

meaningEN: To carry out a plan or task; to run a programme.
commonMistakes: ❌ execute vs perform → ✅ execute = تنفيذ خطة/قرار؛ perform ≠ حول العرض.

Software executes instructions line by line.
Managers must execute the approved strategy.
The move was perfectly executed by the player.

meaningEN: To become involved with something; to interest someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ engage in an activity ✓ → ✅ engage (v.) + in/with.
examples: Students who engage in class learn faster.
The speaker engaged the audience well.
Firms engage in continuous innovation.
The community engaged with the new plan.

meaningEN: To explain in more detail; detailed and complicated.
commonMistakes: ❌ elaborate (v.) نطقها /ɪˈlæbəreɪt/؛ الصفة /ɪˈlæbərət/ → ✅ انتبه للحرف الأخير.

The theory needs to be elaborated with examples.
The plan was more elaborate than necessary.

meaningEN: To accept an idea willingly; to hug someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ embrace the idea ✓ → ✅ embrace (v. + object مباشرة).
examples: Young firms embrace new technology quickly.
The school embraced a project-based approach.
He embraced the challenge of a new role.
They embraced the opportunity warmly.

meaningEN: To appear or come out from somewhere; to become known.
commonMistakes: ❌ emerge from the data → ✅ emerge (بدون من المباشرة)؛ النتائج تظهر من خلال.
examples: New markets emerged after the reforms.
