meaningEN: Gas or other substances released into the air.
commonMistakes: ❌ emission (n.) vs emit (v.) → ✅ count: emissions = انبعاثات.
examples: The country plans to cut carbon emissions by 40%.
Vehicle emissions pollute city air.
Factories must report their emission levels.
Electric cars aim to reduce overall emissions.

meaningEN: To put something or someone in danger.
commonMistakes: ❌ endanger (v.) → ✅ endangered species = أنواع مهددة؛ danger (n.).

meaningEN: To publicly support or approve something.

The clinic endorsed the new medication.
Celebrities often endorse products online.

meaningEN: To gradually wear something away; to weaken.

meaningEN: To ask for information.

meaningEN: To make certain that something happens.

The club ensures access for everyone.

meaningEN: To increase quickly or become more serious.

meaningEN: To send goods to another country for sale.
commonMistakes: ❌ export نطقها كاسم /ˈekspɔːt/ وكفعل /ɪkˈspɔːt/ → ✅ انتبه للنبرة.

Exports grew faster than imports this year.

meaningEN: To show something that was hidden; to uncover.

meaningEN: More than is needed or allowed.

meaningEN: To describe or draw something carefully and clearly.

meaningEN: To take something away from someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ deprive someone of something ✓ → ✅ لا تُقل deprive something من دون of.

meaningEN: Causing harm or damage.
commonMistakes: ❌ detrimental to + شيء ✓ → ✅ لا تُقل detrimental for غالباً؛ to أشيع.
examples: Smoking is detrimental to health.

meaningEN: A difference between two things that should be the same.
commonMistakes: ❌ discrepancy (n.) → ✅ discrepancy between/in.
examples: Auditors found a discrepancy in the accounts.
There is a clear discrepancy between the two reports.
The diagram shows the discrepancy in scores.
Small discrepancies can hide larger problems.

meaningEN: Disagreement with an official view.
commonMistakes: ❌ dissent vs descent → ✅ dissent = معارضة؛ descent = نزول/أصل.
examples: The vote passed with little dissent.
Students are free to voice dissent politely.
The theory drew dissent from several experts.
Dissent can improve group decisions.

meaningEN: Very different from each other; moving apart.
commonMistakes: ❌ divergent vs divergent → ✅ divergent views = وجهات نظر متعارضة.
examples: The two studies reached divergent conclusions.
Members hold divergent views on the policy.
Divergent needs require flexible solutions.
Their careers took divergent paths.

meaningEN: To get a reaction or information from someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ elicit vs illicit → ✅ elicit = verb (يستحث)؛ illicit = غير قانوني (صفة).
examples: The question elicited a strong response.

Open questions elicit richer detail than closed ones.

meaningEN: To make a law official; to perform an action.
commonMistakes: ❌ enact a law ✓ → ✅ enact vs pass → enact = إصدار نهائي؛ pass = إقرار برلماني.

Reforms were enacted in stages.

meaningEN: To try hard to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ endeavour to do ✓ → ✅ endeavor (AmE)؛ endeavour (BrE).

Science is a collective human endeavour.

Learning is an endeavour that never truly ends.

meaningEN: To involve something as a necessary part.
commonMistakes: ❌ entail (v. متعدٍ مباشر) → ✅ entail + object/gerund.
examples: The job entails frequent travel.
Moving abroad entails a large financial cost.

meaningEN: To imagine a future situation.
commonMistakes: ❌ envisage (BrE) vs envision (AmE) → ✅ كلاهما = يتصور.
examples: The plan envisages a 20% rise in capacity.

meaningEN: Not subject to a rule; to free from a rule.
commonMistakes: ❌ be exempt from ✓ → ✅ exempt (adj.) ← الإعفاء؛ exempt (v.) + from.

meaningEN: To develop a plan, idea, or question carefully.
commonMistakes: ❌ formulate vs formulate a question ✓ → ✅ صياغة افتراض/خطة.
examples: The team formulated a clear action plan.

The agency is formulating fresh guidelines.

meaningEN: To make it harder for something to happen.
commonMistakes: ❌ hinder someone from doing ✓ → ✅ hinder + object / hinder from doing.
examples: Poor roads hinder economic development.
Heavy traffic hindered the emergency response.
Lack of funding hinders new projects.
Don't let small doubts hinder your progress.

meaningEN: About to happen very soon.
commonMistakes: ❌ imminent vs eminent → ✅ imminent = وشيك؛ eminent = بارز/شهير (Imminent: forthcoming).
examples: The company warned of imminent job cuts.
Residents fled from the imminent flood.
A decision on the permit is imminent.
The storm's arrival was imminent.

meaningEN: Done secretly and quietly.
commonMistakes: ❌ clandestine (adj.) → ✅ غالباً مع meetings/operations؛ ليست فعل.
examples: The agents held a clandestine meeting in a basement.

Clandestine trade flourished under the embargo.
The plan was kept clandestine until the final day.

meaningEN: Very cheerful, excited, and energetic.
commonMistakes: ❌ ebullient (adj.) → ✅ تُكتب بـ ebu-؛ لا تخلطها مع exuberant.
examples: Her ebullient nature lifted the team's spirits.

meaningEN: Lasting for a very short time.

examples: Social media fame is often ephemeral.

The storm was ephemeral but destructive.

meaningEN: Very careful about details; hard to please.
commonMistakes: ❌ fastidious about/in → ✅ fastidious (+ about)؛ شديد التدقيق.
examples: She is fastidious about the accuracy of every figure.

Critics praised the fastidious attention to detail.

meaningEN: Too great or extreme to be described in words.
commonMistakes: ❌ ineffable (adj.) → ✅ غالباً joy/beauty؛ لا تخلطها مع ineffable=indescribable.

The sunset had an ineffable beauty.

There was an ineffable calm before the ceremony.
The bond between them was almost ineffable.

meaningEN: An extremely large number.

❌ myriad (n.) تلفظ /ˈmɪriəd/.
examples: The app offers a myriad of helpful features.

Challenges come in myriad forms.

meaningEN: Causing great harm in a gradual, hidden way.
commonMistakes: ❌ pernicious vs malicious → ✅ pernicious = ضرر تدريجي بطيء؛ malicious = خبث متعمد.

meaningEN: A state of not knowing what to do.

The question left the panel in a quandary.

meaningEN: Most noticeable or important.
commonMistakes: ❌ salient vs prominent → ✅ متقاربان؛ salient = النقاط الأهم التي تبرز.
examples: The report highlights the salient points.
A salient feature of the city is its parks.
The salient issue was not the fee but the timing.
Key players shaped the most salient debates.
The graph marks the salient trends clearly.

meaningEN: Unnecessary; more than is needed.
commonMistakes: ❌ superfluous vs abundant → ✅ superfluous = زائد وغير ضروري تحديداً.
examples: The edit cut several superfluous paragraphs.
Technology can render some jobs superfluous.
Avoid superfluous words in formal writing.
The extra tables seemed superfluous to the event.
Every point should add value, not superfluous padding.

meaningEN: Something you say or write when you reply to a question.
commonMistakes: ❌ answer of the question → ✅ answer to the question.
examples: Please write the answer on the exam paper.
She gave a short answer to my question.
He answered the phone on the first ring.
I don't know the answer to this question.

meaningEN: To say or write something to get information or help.
commonMistakes: ❌ ask to him → ✅ ask him.
examples: May I ask you a question?
She asked me for help with her homework.
He asked the teacher to explain the rules again.
Don't be afraid to ask for directions.

meaningEN: To start doing something or start to happen.
commonMistakes: ❌ begin to try and begin trying: ✅ أيضاً مقبولة — لكن لا نقول 'begin involving' هكذا.
examples: The meeting will begin at nine o'clock.
She began to learn English when she was a child.
We begin every lesson with a short warm-up.
The film begins with a famous song.

meaningEN: A basic food made from flour and water that is baked.
commonMistakes: ❌ breads → ✅ bread (غير معدودة عادةً) — لكن 'breads' تُستخدم للأنواع المختلفة.
examples: We bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
He eats a slice of bread with breakfast every day.
Fresh bread smells wonderful.
Could you pass me the bread, please?

meaningEN: A solid food made from milk.
commonMistakes: ❌ a cheese → ✅ a piece of cheese / some cheese (غير معدودة).
examples: I would like a cheese sandwich, please.
France is famous for its local cheese.
She put a piece of cheese on the table.
This cheese comes from a small family farm.

meaningEN: The things that people wear, such as shirts, dresses and trousers.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'cloth' هو قماش، بينما الملبوسات جمعها 'clothes' — ❌ a cloths → ✅ clothes.
examples: I have bought some new clothes for the winter.
She put on her warm clothes before going out.
This clothes shop sells good-quality shirts.
We can donate old clothes to charity.

meaningEN: A hot drink made from roasted coffee beans.
commonMistakes: ❌ a coffee → تُستخدم أحياناً لمعنى كوب؛ المقاعد: ✅ Would you like a coffee?
examples: I drink a cup of coffee every morning.
She ordered a strong black coffee.
We usually meet at a coffee shop on Saturdays.
Would you like some coffee with your cake?

meaningEN: A person who drives a vehicle.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'driver' صاحب السيارة، و 'passenger' الراكب.
examples: The bus driver stopped at every station.
My father is a careful driver.
You need a driver's licence to drive legally.
The taxi driver knew the shortest route.

meaningEN: The time that will come after the present.
commonMistakes: ❌ in future يوم بمعنى 'من الآن فصاعداً' — ✅ in the future = في المستقبل.
examples: What are your plans for the future?
We may travel to Mars in the future.
Education is very important for the future.
He is saving money for his future.

meaningEN: To become bigger, or to make plants develop.
commonMistakes: ❌ I grew in a small town → ✅ I grew UP in a small town.
examples: Children grow very quickly.
My grandfather grows vegetables in his garden.
The city has grown in size over the years.
She wants to grow up to be a doctor.

meaningEN: A drug that you take to cure an illness.
commonMistakes: ❌ eat medicine → ✅ take medicine.
examples: The doctor told me to take this medicine twice a day.
He needs medicine for his headache.
Modern medicine has saved many lives.
You should not drink alcohol with this medicine.

meaningEN: A large natural stream of water that flows to the sea.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'river' نهر، بينما 'sea' بحر و 'lake' بحيرة.
examples: There is a bridge across the river.
The river flows into the sea.
Many birds live near the banks of this river.
The river is too deep to swim across.

meaningEN: A sweet substance used in food and drinks.
commonMistakes: ❌ sugars → ✅ sugar (غير معدودة عادةً؛ 'sugars' للأنواع/الإضافة للقيم الغذائية).
examples: I take my coffee with a little sugar.
She is trying to reduce sugar in her diet.
This drink contains too much sugar.
Add two teaspoons of sugar to the mixture.

meaningEN: A vehicle with connected carriages that travels on rails.
commonMistakes: ❌ go by the train → ✅ go by train. / ✅ catch the train.
examples: I catch the train to work every morning.
We travelled to the coast by train.
The next train to London leaves in ten minutes.
She missed her train because she arrived late.

meaningEN: Something that you do for fun or a particular reason.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'activity' جمعها 'activities' (تنتهي بحرف y → ies).
examples: Regular physical activity keeps you healthy.
The school offers many outdoor activities for children.
This is a popular leisure activity in summer.
We organised a group activity for the students.

meaningEN: To say that something is true, especially something bad.
commonMistakes: ❌ admit doing / admit to doing: ✅ كلاهما مقبول، لكن 'admit to' فقط مع الـ gerund لا مع أن تتعدى.
examples: He admitted that he had made a mistake.
She admitted to breaking the window.
The patient was admitted to hospital last night.
He refused to admit defeat.

meaningEN: To tell somebody what you think they should do.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'advise' فعل، و 'advice' اسم — ❌ I adviced you → ✅ I advised you.
examples: The doctor advised him to rest for a week.
I strongly advise you to save some money.
She advised against travelling alone at night.
My lawyer gave me good advice.

meaningEN: To let somebody do something or let something happen.
commonMistakes: ❌ allow to do → ✅ allow someone TO do something — ❌ They allowed him going → ✅ allowed him to go.
examples: My parents allow me to stay out until eleven.
Smoking is not allowed in the building.
Allow enough time for the journey.
The rules allow free entry for children.

meaningEN: Very old, usually from a time long ago.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'ancient' يُستخدم للنصوص/الحضارات، بينما 'old' أعمّ — لا تخلطها مع 'elderly' للأشخاص.
examples: We visited many ancient buildings in Rome.
She is studying ancient history at university.
The ancient civilisation built huge pyramids.
This temple was constructed in ancient times.

meaningEN: To tell people officially about something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'announce' يحتاج مفعولاً: ✅ announce the results — لا نقول announce about.
examples: The company announced a decision to cut prices.
The winner will be announced at the end of the show.
She formally announced her resignation yesterday.
They announced the good news on the radio.

meaningEN: Worried and nervous about something.
commonMistakes: ❌ anxious FOR him في سياق القلق → ✅ anxious ABOUT him — لكن anxious to do = حريص على.
examples: She felt anxious about her exams.
The parents were anxious to see their children.
He gets anxious before every interview.
I am anxious about the test results.

meaningEN: Saying that you are sorry for something you have done.
commonMistakes: ❌ say apology → ✅ make / offer an apology — ❌ apologize و apology: الفعل 'apologise'، الاسم 'apology'.
examples: He made a sincere apology for being late.
She accepted his apology with a smile.
The manager sent a letter of apology.
I owe you an apology for what I said.

meaningEN: The act of reaching a place.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'arrival' اسم و 'arrive' فعل — ❌ the arrive of the train → ✅ the arrival of the train.
examples: Please report to the reception desk on arrival.
Our flight's arrival time is eight o'clock.
The arrival of spring always makes people happy.
We apologise for the late arrival of the train.

meaningEN: A prize given for doing something well.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'award' جائزة رسمية، و 'prize' جائزة مسابقة/جائزة عامة — غالباً مترادفتان لكن award أوسع.
examples: The film won the best actor award.
She received an award for her research.
The award ceremony will be held on Friday.
He has won many prestigious awards.

meaningEN: Feeling tired and impatient because something is not interesting.
commonMistakes: ❌ bored OF → ✅ bored WITH / bored BY — ❌ 'bored' يصف شعورك، و 'boring' يصف الشيء الممل.
examples: He was bored with the same routine every day.
Children get bored quickly in long queues.
I felt bored at home all weekend.
The students looked extremely bored in class.

meaningEN: The money available for something, and the plan for spending it.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'budget' أيضاً فعل: to budget for something — ❌ on budget → ✅ on a budget / within budget.
examples: We have to live on a tight budget this year.
The government announced new budget cuts.
She planned the wedding on a small budget.
The project was completed within budget.

meaningEN: Quiet and peaceful, not excited or worried.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'calm' أيضاً فعل: to calm down — ❌ calm down on someone → ✅ calm somebody down.
examples: She stayed calm during the emergency.
The sea was calm all afternoon.
He spoke in a calm voice.
Take a deep breath to keep calm.

meaningEN: A series of planned actions to achieve a goal.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'campaign' (ن) / 'campaigner' (ن شخص) — لا تخلطها مع 'campus' (الحرم الجامعي).
examples: The company launched an advertising campaign.
She worked on the election campaign all summer.
They started a campaign against smoking in schools.
The campaign raised millions of dollars.

meaningEN: To make something happen.
commonMistakes: ❌ degrees: 'cause' (فعل/اسم) و 'because' حرف عطف — ❌ The cause is because → ✅ The cause is that...
examples: Heavy rain caused serious damage to the roads.
The storm caused a long delay at the airport.
What was the cause of the accident?
The new policy caused concern among workers.

meaningEN: Sure that something is true, or a particular one.
commonMistakes: ❌ certain FOR → ✅ certain ABOUT / certain OF — ❌ I am certain that... ✅ صحيح.
examples: I am certain that she will come.
Make certain the door is locked before you leave.
A certain amount of stress is normal.
Only certain kinds of plants grow here.

meaningEN: A person who legally belongs to a country or lives in a city.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'citizen' مواطن / 'citizenship' المواطنة — لا تخلطها مع 'resident' (مقيم).
examples: She became a citizen of the country last year.
The city offers discounts for senior citizens.
Every citizen has the duty to vote.
He is an ordinary citizen, not a politician.

meaningEN: To try to win something or be better than others.
commonMistakes: ❌ compete TO someone → ✅ compete AGAINST / compete WITH someone — ✅ compete FOR a prize.
examples: The two teams will compete for the trophy.
She will compete in the final next week.
Small shops cannot compete with the big supermarkets.
Many students compete for the scholarship.

meaningEN: A contest, or the activity of trying to win.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'competition' أيضاً بمعنى المنافسة في السوق — ✅ strong competition from rivals.
examples: She won first prize in the writing competition.
There is fierce competition for jobs.
He entered a cooking competition on TV.
The competition between the two companies is intense.

meaningEN: The feeling that you can trust somebody or do something well.
commonMistakes: ❌ have confidence TO someone → ✅ have confidence IN someone — ✅ confidence in doing something.
examples: Speaking English on stage increased her confidence.
He lacks confidence in his speaking skills.
The team gained confidence after the victory.
I have full confidence in your ability.

meaningEN: Sure that you can do something well.
commonMistakes: ❌ confident FOR → ✅ confident ABOUT / confident OF — ❌ 'confident' (صفة) و 'confidence' (اسم).
examples: She feels confident about the interview.
He is confident of winning the match.
You should be confident in your own abilities.
The presenter was calm and self-confident.

meaningEN: The ability to do something difficult or dangerous.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'courage' غير معدودة — ❌ a courage → ✅ courage / an act of courage.
examples: She showed great courage during the crisis.
It takes courage to admit a mistake.
He had the courage to speak the truth.
The firefighter acted with courage.

meaningEN: An act that is against the law.
commonMistakes: ❌ do a crime → ✅ commit a crime.
examples: The police are investigating the crime.
He committed a crime and went to prison.
The crime rate has fallen in recent years.
Evidence was collected at the crime scene.

meaningEN: A large number of people in one place.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'crowd' يمكن أن يُستخدم كفعل: to crowd around — ❌ crowds جمعها crowDDs بإملاء؟ الصحيح crowds.
examples: A large crowd gathered to watch the concert.
The crowd cheered when the goal was scored.
Police were needed for crowd control.
The event attracted a huge crowd.

meaningEN: A person who buys goods or services from a shop or company.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'customer' في المتاجر، و 'client' للخدمات المهنية (محامٍ/مستشار).
examples: The shop offers excellent customer service.
She is a regular customer at this café.
Happy customers recommend the product to friends.
We aim to attract new customers every month.

meaningEN: A choice that you make after thinking.
commonMistakes: ❌ do a decision → ✅ MAKE a decision — ❌ 'decide' فعل، 'decision' اسم.
examples: She made a decision to study abroad.
It was a difficult decision for the family.
We need more information to come to a decision.
The committee reached a decision after a long debate.

meaningEN: To make something happen later than planned.
commonMistakes: ❌ delay TO do → ✅ delay doing / delay the trip — ❌ 'delay' (فعل/اسم) و 'delayed' (صفة).
examples: The flight was delayed by heavy snow.
They decided to delay the meeting until Friday.
Please respond without delay.
There was a long delay at the border.

meaningEN: To say that something is not true, or refuse to allow.
commonMistakes: ❌ deny to do → ✅ deny doing / deny that — 'refuse' تستخدم مع to، أما 'deny' فمع gerund أو that.
examples: He denied any involvement in the accident.
The company strongly denied the claim.
She denied breaking the vase.
They were denied access to the building.

meaningEN: To damage something so badly that it no longer exists.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'destroy' شيء ملموس/مجرد — لا تقل 'destruct' — ✅ destroy + object.
examples: The fire destroyed the old building.
The storm completely destroyed the crops.
Pollution is destroying the environment.
The bad news destroyed all her hopes.

meaningEN: The process of growing or improving, or a new event.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'development' اسم، و 'develop' فعل — ❌ developement → ✅ development (بدون e بعد p).
examples: The country has seen rapid economic development.
These are the latest developments in the story.
Reading is vital for child development.
She works in software development.

meaningEN: The way in which people or things are not the same.
commonMistakes: ❌ the different between → ✅ the DIFFERENCE between — ❌ 'difference' اسم و 'different' صفة.
examples: There is a big difference between the two plans.
Your help made a real difference to me.
Can you notice the difference in taste?
We must respect cultural differences.

meaningEN: The way that somebody or something moves or faces.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'directions' غالباً جمع بمعنى الإرشادات — ❌ ask direction → ✅ ask FOR directions.
examples: We walked in the wrong direction.
He stopped to ask for directions.
The project is moving in the right direction.
She has a very poor sense of direction.

meaningEN: To have a different opinion from somebody.
commonMistakes: ❌ disagree TO → ✅ disagree WITH someone / disagree ABOUT something — ❌ I disagree that... مقبول أيضاً.
examples: I disagree with your opinion completely.
They disagree about how to spend the money.
You may strongly disagree, but hear me out.
We agreed to disagree and remained friends.

meaningEN: Pictures in your mind while you sleep, or something you hope for.
commonMistakes: ❌ dream ABOUT يف ينام... بشكل صحيح: dream of/about doing — ✅ dream of becoming a doctor.
examples: I had a strange dream last night.
Her dream is to become a pilot.
He finally got his dream job.
Never give up on your dreams.

meaningEN: Something that you must do because it is right or your job.
commonMistakes: ❌ duty OF someone → ✅ the duty OF someone / it is your duty TO do something.
examples: The nurse is on duty tonight.
It is every citizen's duty to vote.
He felt a strong sense of duty to his family.
Officers must perform their duty honestly.

meaningEN: To get money by working, or to deserve something.
commonMistakes: ❌ earn a benefit / win a prize: 'earn' للمال/الاستحقاق، 'win' للمسابقات — ❌ Win a salary → ✅ earn a salary.
examples: She earns a good salary as a teacher.
He earns his living by painting houses.
Hard work earns you respect.
They earned a lot of money from the sales.

meaningEN: Teaching and learning, especially at a school or university.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'education' عملية التعلّم، و 'knowledge' المعرفة — لا تقل 'educate' كصفة: ✅ educational system / an educated person.
examples: Every child has the right to education.
She works in higher education.
The government wants to improve the education system.
He received a good education at a private school.

meaningEN: A change that something causes in somebody or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ affect (فعل) و effect (اسم) — ❌ The news had a big affect → ✅ ... had a big effect — ✅ to affects... لا؛ to affect = يؤثر.
examples: The new law had a positive effect on safety.
The medicine can have serious side effects.
Pollution has a harmful effect on health.
The smoking ban came into effect last year.

meaningEN: A sudden serious situation that needs immediate action.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'an emergency' مفرد، 'emergencies' جمع — ❌ emergency's → ✅ emergencies.
examples: Call 999 in an emergency.
Please use the emergency exit if there is a fire.
The hospital treated it as a medical emergency.
Emergency services arrived within minutes.

meaningEN: The power to work or move, or the power to run machines.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'energy' غير معدودة — ❌ energies في سياق عام; لكن 'energies' تستخدم لجهود الشخص.
examples: Children have so much energy.
We should use more renewable energy.
Switch off the lights to save energy.
The city hopes to rely on solar energy.

meaningEN: A person whose job is to design and build machines, roads, etc.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'engineer' (اسم) و 'engineering' (هندسة/تخصص) — ❌ he studies engineer → ✅ he studies engineering.
examples: Her brother works as a civil engineer.
A software engineer designed the new app.
The engineer fixed the broken machine.
She is studying mechanical engineering.

meaningEN: To go or come into a place, or to join in something.
commonMistakes: ❌ enter INTO a room → ✅ enter a room (بدون into غالباً) — لكن 'enter into' مع الاتفاقيات مقبولة.
examples: Please knock before you enter the office.
She entered the competition last week.
Type your password and press enter.
They entered into an agreement to share costs.

meaningEN: The tools or machines needed for a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ equipments → ✅ equipment (غير معدودة) — ❌ an equipment → ✅ a piece of equipment.
examples: The gym has modern exercise equipment.
You need safety equipment for this job.
This is an essential piece of laboratory equipment.
They bought new office equipment for the team.

meaningEN: To get away from a place or a dangerous situation.
commonMistakes: ❌ escape of the fire → ✅ escape FROM a place — 'escape' أيضاً اسم للنفق/مهرب.
examples: The prisoner tried to escape from jail.
They escaped the fire through the back door.
It was a narrow escape from death.
The mistake escaped the teacher's attention.

meaningEN: Something that shows what a thing is like or how to do it.
commonMistakes: ❌ for example TO illustrate... — ✅ for example, ... — لا تكتب example اسماً بعيد لـ 'exemple'.
examples: The teacher gave an example of a good essay.
Fruits, for example, are full of vitamins.
This town is a perfect example of sustainable living.
Please describe one example from your experience.

meaningEN: To make somebody feel happy and enthusiastic.
commonMistakes: ❌ excited ABOUT و exciting للشيء — ❌ I am exciting for the trip → ✅ I am excited about the trip.
examples: The news excited the whole crowd.
The project excites great interest among students.
I am so excited about my holiday.
She was excited to meet her favourite author.

meaningEN: A public show of art, products, or other items.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'exhibition' معرض فني/علمي، و'exposition' لميترو النقاش... لا تخلط مع 'show'.
examples: The museum is holding a photography exhibition.
We visited an art exhibition last week.
The company took part in a trade exhibition.
The exhibition hall was packed with visitors.

meaningEN: A scientific test to see what happens or to answer a question.
commonMistakes: ❌ make an experiment → ✅ DO / CONDUCT / CARRY OUT an experiment.
examples: The students carried out a simple experiment in class.
Experiments show that sleep helps memory.
The results of the experiment were surprising.
Scientists must repeat an experiment to confirm it.

meaningEN: Known about by many people.
commonMistakes: ❌ famous BY → ✅ famous FOR — لا تخلط 'fame' (اسم) مع 'famous' (صفة).
examples: Egypt is famous for its ancient monuments.
She became world-famous after the film.
The restaurant is famous for fresh seafood.
He is a famous scientist in his field.

meaningEN: The popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'fashion' (موضة) و 'fashionable' (رائج/أنيق) — ❌ a fashion trend وغيرها مقبولة.
examples: Short dresses were in fashion that summer.
She studies fashion design at college.
These shoes have gone out of fashion.
The fashion industry changes very quickly.

meaningEN: The person or thing that is responsible for a mistake or problem.
commonMistakes: ❌ fault OF someone's responsibility — ✅ It is MY fault — ❌ not a blame: blame فعل/اسم مختلف.
examples: The accident was not my fault.
She is always finding fault with my work.
A minor fault in the engine caused the problem.
The driver was clearly at fault.

meaningEN: The feeling you have when you are afraid.
commonMistakes: ❌ fear OF something (وليس from) — ❌ afraid هو الصفة، fear هو الاسم/الفعل.
examples: She has a fear of flying.
He could not overcome his fear of speaking.
They lived in fear during the storm.
Fear of failure stops many people from trying.

meaningEN: An emotion or a physical sensation.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'feeling' (شعور) و 'emotion' (انفعال/عاطفة) — قابل للتبديل أحياناً.
examples: She had a strange feeling that someone was watching.
I have a feeling that we will win.
Try not to hurt his feelings.
A warm feeling of satisfaction spread over me.

meaningEN: An area of land, or a subject or area of work.
commonMistakes: ❌ in the field OF medicine / in the medical field — ✅ كلاهما صحيح لكن لا تخلط الصيغ.
examples: Cows were grazing in the field.
She is an expert in the field of genetics.
The students did field research in the village.
He is well known in the field of education.

meaningEN: To use force or effort against someone or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ fight WITH someone (يتشاجر مع) / fight FOR something (يناضل من أجل) — الحرفان مختلفان!
examples: They fought bravely for their country.
Doctors are fighting against the disease.
Two boys were fighting over the ball.
The charity fights poverty in rural areas.

meaningEN: A number, a shape, or a person of importance.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'figure out' = يحل/يفهم (فعل مركب) — لا تقل figure OUT TO...
examples: The sales figures have improved this year.
He is a public figure in politics.
Research shows a figure in the millions.
Let me figure out the total cost.

meaningEN: After a long time; at the end.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'finally' (أخيراً) و 'final' (نهائي) — ❌ finnaly → ✅ finally.
examples: The train finally arrived after two hours.
She finally decided to move abroad.
Finally, I want to thank everyone here.
We finally reached the top of the mountain.

meaningEN: A journey in a plane, or an act of flying.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'flight' تحتاج للطائرة، و'flying' حرفة — لا تقل a fly.
examples: We booked a direct flight to Cairo.
The flight takes three hours.
The flight attendant offered us drinks.
Her flight was cancelled due to the storm.

meaningEN: To not remember something.
commonMistakes: ❌ forgot to bring / forgot bringing: المعنيان مختلفان — forget TO do (لم يحدث)، forget DOING (حدث فعلاً).
examples: Don't forget to lock the door.
She forgot about the meeting completely.
I will never forget the day we met.
He forgot his umbrella on the train.

meaningEN: The right to do what you want without being controlled.
commonMistakes: ❌ freedom OF something (وليس from) — ✅ freedom from fear = تحرر من الخوف.
examples: Freedom of speech is a basic human right.
They fought for freedom under a harsh ruler.
Birds in the wild enjoy a sense of freedom.
Everyone has the freedom to choose a job.

meaningEN: A shop, or a place where things are kept.
commonMistakes: ❌ في 'the store' (المتجر) / و'in store' (مخزون) — لا تخلط 'store' (متجر، شائعة أمريكياً) مع 'shop' (محل، بريطانية).
examples: I bought the milk at a grocery store.
The warehouse stores food for the winter.
They sell clothes in an online store.
The computer stores all your files.

meaningEN: Very bad weather with strong wind, heavy rain, etc.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'storm' الأرضي... أما 'flood' فيضان/ 'hurricane' إعصار — دقّق في الكلمات.
examples: A violent storm hit the coast last night.
The storm damaged many houses.
We waited inside until the storm passed.
A snow storm closed the mountain roads.

meaningEN: A person you do not know.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'stranger' شخص غريب عنك، أما 'foreigner' أجنبي من بلد آخر — لا تخلط.
examples: Never accept sweets from a stranger.
A complete stranger helped me with my bags.
He is a stranger to this city.
She was shy of meeting strangers.

meaningEN: Pressure or worry caused by problems in your life.
commonMistakes: ❌ stress ON... لمعنى التشديد اللغوي؛ الضغط النفسي: under stress / feel stressed.
examples: She works well under stress.
Exam stress affects many students.
Exercise helps people manage stress.
He left his stressful job and moved abroad.

meaningEN: Making sure rules are obeyed; not allowing fun or freedom.
commonMistakes: ❌ strict WITH children / strict ABOUT punctuality — الحرفان مختلفان!
examples: Our school has strict rules about uniforms.
The teacher is very strict with us.
Parents should be strict about bedtime.
Strictly speaking, this is not allowed.

meaningEN: A thing that is being talked or studied about.
commonMistakes: ❌ subject FOR discussion → ✅ subject OF discussion — 'subject to' تعني خاضع لـ، و'be subject to' فعل مختلفة تماماً عن اسم 'subject'.
examples: History is her favourite school subject.
We discussed the subject of climate change.
Let's change the subject, please.
The lecture was on the subject of genetics.

meaningEN: Achieving what you wanted to do or get.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'success' اسم و 'succeed' فعل — ❌ he make success... ✅ he succeeded / it was a success.
examples: The play was a huge success.
Hard work is the key to success.
She achieved success in her career at a young age.
Failure is part of the road to success.

meaningEN: Right for a particular person or purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ suitable TO someone → ✅ suitable FOR someone — الصفة السلبية هي 'unsuitable' وليس 'unsuitably'.
examples: This film is not suitable for young children.
We need to find a suitable time for the meeting.
The apartment is suitable for a family.
She wore suitable clothes for hiking.

meaningEN: Complete or total; not limited or doubted.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'absolutely' (ظرف) للتأكيد: absolutely right — لا نكتب absolutely 'تامة'... ✅ absolute = مطلق.
examples: The king had absolute power in the past.
We need absolute silence during the exam.
I have absolute confidence in her ability.
Fresh water is an absolute necessity.

meaningEN: To take in liquid, heat, or information.
commonMistakes: ❌ absorbed INTO 생각ها → ✅ absorbed IN her book (منشغل تماماً) — وهناك absorbed BY لليمتص.
examples: Plants absorb water through their roots.
Students absorb new information quickly when interested.
The walls absorb sound and reduce noise.
She was completely absorbed in her novel.

meaningEN: To go somewhere with somebody.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'accompany' يحتاج مفعولاً مباشراً: ✅ accompany someone (لا نقول accompany with someone).
examples: He accompanied his mother to the doctor.
The programme is accompanied by a study guide.
A nurse accompanied the patient to the clinic.
Thunder was accompanied by heavy rain.

meaningEN: A formal agreement, especially between countries.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'of your own accord' = بمحض إرادتك (عبارة ثابتة) — 'according to' = وفقاً لـ.
examples: The two nations signed a peace accord.
The companies reached an accord on pricing.
His actions are in accord with his words.
The dog walked home of its own accord.

meaningEN: Sudden and unexpected, or rude and quick in speech.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'abrupt' بمعنى 'فجائي' للحدث، وبمعنى 'خشن/مختصر' في الأسلوب — لا تخلط مع 'sudden' فقط.
examples: The meeting came to an abrupt end.
There has been an abrupt change in the weather.
Her abrupt departure surprised everyone.
He gave an abrupt answer and walked away.

meaningEN: Harming someone, or using something in a wrong way.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'abuse' كاسم تُنطق /əˈbjuːs/، وكفعل /əˈbjuːz/ — الفعلان مختلفا النطق.
examples: The report documents abuse of power by officials.
Drug abuse destroys many young lives.
She spoke out against verbal abuse at work.
The charity helps victims of domestic abuse.

meaningEN: The chance or right to use or enter something.
commonMistakes: ❌ access TO something (وليس of) — ❌ 'access' اسم/فعل: to access files ✅.
examples: Students have free access to the library.
You can access your files from anywhere.
The building has easy access for wheelchairs.
She gained access to the private database.

meaningEN: Correct and exact in every detail.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'accurate' مطابق للواقع بدقة، و'precise' دقيق التفاصيل — لا تخلط مع 'correct' بشكل عام.
examples: The report provides accurate information.
The forecast was surprisingly accurate.
You need accurate data to make good decisions.
Her description of the event was completely accurate.

meaningEN: A person who cannot stop doing or taking something harmful.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'addicted TO' (وليس with) — ❌ 'addict' (اسم) و 'addicted' (صفة) و 'addiction' (اسم المرض).
examples: He became a drug addict in his twenties.
She is addicted to online games.
The centre helps gambling addicts recover.
Addiction is a serious health problem.

meaningEN: To deal with a problem, or to make a formal speech.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'address' هنا فعل (يعالج/يخاطب) وليس مكان السكن — 'address of' خطأ: ✅ address TO an audience.
examples: The government must address the housing problem.
She addressed the students at graduation.
We need to address the issue immediately.
The president addressed the nation last night.

meaningEN: To make a change in somebody or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'affect' فعل و 'effect' اسم — ❌ The rain will effect the game → ✅ The rain will AFFECT the game.
examples: The new law will affect thousands of families.
Sleep loss affects your concentration.
The town was badly affected by the flood.
Bad weather can affect the outcome of a match.

meaningEN: Behaving in a threatening or forceful way.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'aggressive' في التسويق تعني 'هجومي/عنيف البيع' — لا تخلط مع 'offensive'.
examples: His aggressive behaviour worried the teachers.
The dog became aggressive with visitors.
The company used aggressive marketing strategies.
An aggressive tone can start a fight.

meaningEN: To put things in a straight line, or to support the same idea.
commonMistakes: ❌ align TO → ✅ align WITH — 'aligned with our goals' — ✅.
examples: Align the text to the centre of the page.
Our goals are aligned with the company's vision.
She aligned herself with the reform group.
The wheels need to be aligned properly.

meaningEN: Similar to each other.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'alike' لا تأتي قبل الاسم — ✅ The two brothers are alike (وليس 'alike brothers') — للتمييز استخدم 'similar'.
examples: The twins look exactly alike.
Teachers and students alike enjoyed the festival.
The two stories are alike in many ways.
Great minds think alike, as they say.

meaningEN: A serious request, or the quality that attracts people.
commonMistakes: ❌ appeal FOR money / appeal TO someone ✓ → ✅ ملاحظة: الفعل أيضاً تعني 'يطلب/يلفت الانتباه'.
examples: The charity made an appeal for donations.
The film has a broad appeal to all ages.
The design appeals to young audiences.
The verdict was overturned on appeal.

meaningEN: The feeling that something is good or acceptable.
commonMistakes: ❌ approve (v.) vs approval (n.) → ✅ على حروف الإملاء: approve/approval.
examples: The plan met with the board's approval.
The drug was granted approval last year.
Her approval rating rose after the speech.
The project needs approval from the council.

meaningEN: Not exactly, but close to a number or amount.
commonMistakes: ❌ approximately 500 → ✅ تكتب عادة اختصاراً 'approx.' — تذكر نطقها /əˈprɒksɪmətli/.
examples: The journey takes approximately two hours.
Approximately 200 people attended the lecture.
The budget increased by approximately 10%.
Prices vary between approximately $5 and $15.

meaningEN: A person who helps somebody with their job.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'assistant' من assist (يساعد) → ✅ لا تخلط مع 'assistance' (مساعدة).
examples: She works as a research assistant at the lab.
Please direct your questions to the assistant.
The manager hired a new administrative assistant.
A personal assistant arranged his entire schedule.

meaningEN: To connect something with something else.
commonMistakes: ❌ associate...+with ✓ → ✅ بمعنى 'مرافق' كاسم تقرأ /əˈsəʊʃiət/.
examples: Most people associate red with danger.
The brand is closely associated with quality.
Stress is often associated with poor sleep.
They associated the smell with childhood.

meaningEN: To join one thing to another.
commonMistakes: ❌ attach يأتي مباشرة + إلى: attach A to B — الاسم 'attachment' للمرفق.
examples: Please attach your CV to the email.
The button is attached to the front of the jacket.
People attach great importance to education.
The garage is attached to the house.

meaningEN: To use violence or force against somebody.
commonMistakes: ❌ attack TO → ✅ attack something مباشرةً (متعدٍ) — ❌ the attack on... ✓ للوصف.
examples: The city was attacked by air at dawn.
The report attacks the government's policy.
A cyber attack disabled the bank's website.
They launched a coordinated attack on the enemy base.

meaningEN: To try to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ attempt doing → ✅ attempt to do — الاسم: make an attempt.
examples: She attempted to explain the theory simply.
They made a second attempt to cross the river.
He failed his first attempt but passed the second.
In an attempt to save money, they car-share.

meaningEN: The act of watching, listening to or thinking about something.
commonMistakes: ❌ make attention → ✅ PAY attention — 'attention' غير معدودة: a lot of attention.
examples: Students must pay attention in class.
The poster draws attention to the event.
The manager values attention to detail.
The issue has received growing attention.

meaningEN: To make somebody interested in or drawn to something.
commonMistakes: ❌ attract OF → ✅ attract + مفعول مباشر — być attracted to = انجذب إلى.
examples: The festival attracts thousands of visitors.
Bright colours attract attention.
Low taxes attract foreign investment.
She was attracted to the quiet countryside.

meaningEN: The people who watch or listen to a performance.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'audience' يمكن أن تكون مفردة/جمعاً — ✅ The audience was/were... كلاهما مقبول (BrE).
examples: The audience applauded for a long time.
The programme targets a young audience.
The speaker connected well with the audience.
A studio audience watched the recording.

meaningEN: Working by itself without needing humans to operate it.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'automatic' صفة و'automatically' ظرف — ❌ He does it automatic → ✅ automatically.
examples: The doors open automatically.
I set up an automatic payment for my rent.
The camera focuses and it is fully automatic.
Answering an email can be an automatic habit.

meaningEN: The bottom part of something, or the main place where you work.
commonMistakes: ❌ base vs basis → ✅ base = قاعدة مادية؛ basis = أساس مجرد (on the basis of).
examples: The team has a large customer base.
The base of the statue is made of marble.
We based our decision on the latest data.
The camp is based in the desert.

meaningEN: A device that stores electricity for power.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'a battery of tests' = سلسلة اختبارات (مجازاً غير كهربائية) — تعدد المعاني.
examples: My phone battery dies by mid-afternoon.
Rechargeable batteries last longer.
The car runs on a large lithium battery.
Candidates face a battery of aptitude tests.

meaningEN: Short and not lasting a long time.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'brief' (موجز) و 'abbreviate' (يختصر) — الاسم breachليس بريف؛ انتبه للمعنى.
examples: The report gives a brief overview of the market.
He made a brief appearance at the meeting.
Keep your answer brief and clear.
In brief, the experiment failed.

meaningEN: Wide; including many different things.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'broad' له معنى مجازي (واسع النطاق) — لا تخلط مع 'wide' المادي/المجازي القابل للتبادل.
examples: The course covers a broad range of topics.
There is broad agreement among scientists.
She has broad experience in education.
The river is very broad at this point.

meaningEN: A heavy load or a duty that is hard to carry.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'burden' أيضاً فعل = يثقل — ❌ bear the burden of ✓.
examples: Old age pensions ease the burden on families.
The burden of proof lies with the claimant.
Debt became a heavy burden for the household.
He bore the burden of leadership alone.

meaningEN: To find an answer using mathematics or logic.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'calculate' حساب رياضي/تقدير — لا تخلط مع 'count' (عدّ).
examples: Calculate the total cost including tax.
We need to calculate the average score.
The delay was calculated at two hours.
She calculated her expenses carefully.

meaningEN: The grounds and buildings of a university or college.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'campus' لا علاقة لها بـ'camp' — ✅ on campus (بدون the) هي الأكثر شيوعاً.
examples: Most students live on campus.
The library is in the centre of the campus.
Campus life is full of clubs and events.
The new campus will open next year.

meaningEN: A chemical element found in all living things and fuels.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'carbon' غالباً عنصر، وفي الطاقة لها معانٍ كثيرة — انتبه للسياق.
examples: Burning fuels releases carbon dioxide.
The company aims to be carbon neutral by 2035.
A carbon tax raises the price of fossil fuels.
We can cut our carbon footprint by cycling.

meaningEN: An official public event where formal acts take place.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'ceremony' (مراسم) و 'ritual' (طقس ديني) و 'festival' (مهرجان) — لا تخلط.
examples: The opening ceremony starts at noon.
Thousands attended the award ceremony.
The wedding ceremony lasted an hour.
A simple ceremony marked the anniversary.

meaningEN: Connected with citizens or ordinary people.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'civil' نطقها /ˈsɪvl/ وليس /sɪˈvaɪl/ — معانيها حول المواطنين.
examples: The civil war lasted six years.
Civil rights protect all citizens equally.
She studied civil engineering at university.
Public servants form the backbone of civil society.

meaningEN: To put things into groups according to type.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'class' اسم و'classify' فعل التصنيف — ✅ The data is classified as (تُصنَّف).
examples: Books are classified according to subject.
The report is classified as confidential.
Scientists classify animals by their structure.
The files were classified into three groups.

meaningEN: The typical weather of an area over a long time.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'climate' مناخ طويل المدى، و'weather' حالة الطقس اليوم — لا تخلط.
examples: Climate change threatens coastal cities.
The region enjoys a mild climate.
Businesses face a difficult economic climate.
Governments agreed on a new climate policy.

meaningEN: A set of rules or symbols used to communicate.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'code' معانيها متعددة (شيفرة، قوانين، أكواد برمجية) — انتبه للسياق.
examples: The building has a strict dress code.
The spy decoded the secret code.
She writes code for a tech company.
Enter the area code before the number.

meaningEN: To put two or more things together.
commonMistakes: ❌ combine to each other → ✅ combine A with B — 'combine' التصريف: combines/combined.
examples: The course combines theory with practice.
She combined work and study successfully.
Mix the ingredients and combine them well.
The two firms combined their research efforts.

meaningEN: Making you feel relaxed physically, or having enough money.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'comfortable' (مريح) و 'convenient' (عملي/موائم) — لا يترادفان دائماً.
examples: The new sofa is very comfortable.
Make yourself comfortable while I prepare tea.
They live on a comfortable income.
I don't feel comfortable with that decision.

meaningEN: Looking at how people or things are similar and different.
commonMistakes: ❌ make a comparison TO → ✅ comparison BETWEEN A and B / comparison WITH.
examples: In comparison with last year, sales are up.
It is useful to make a comparison between the two.
The second plan is cheaper by comparison.
She drew a comparison between animals and humans.

meaningEN: To accept something quietly without arguing.
commonMistakes: ❌ acquire vs acquiesce — ✅ acquiesce = يسلم بصمت؛ acquire = يكتسب.
examples: The board acquiesced to the new rules.
She acquiesced in the plan without complaint.
Few citizens acquiesced to the higher tax.
He did not acquiesce easily to criticism.

meaningEN: Determined not to change your opinion.
commonMistakes: ❌ adamant TO → ✅ adamant THAT / adamant about — صفة من 'ديمانت' (حجر شديد).
examples: She was adamant that the plan should go ahead.
He remained adamant about his decision.
The manager was adamant on quality standards.
They were adamant in refusing the offer.

meaningEN: An opponent in a contest or argument.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'adversary' (ن) و'adversarial' (صفة) — لا تخلط مع adverse (معاكس).
examples: He respected his political adversary.
Chess taught her to study before defeating an adversary.
The two old adversaries finally shook hands.
The champion faced a worthy adversary.

meaningEN: Connected with beauty and the enjoyment of art.
collocations: from an aesthetic point of view
commonMistakes: ❌ نطقها إس-ثيتيك وليس أاس-ثيتيك — ✅ افتحها بحرف e طويل: /iːsˈθetɪk/.
examples: The building has great aesthetic appeal.
Design balances function and aesthetics.
From an aesthetic point of view, the result is poor.
Some objects hold more aesthetic than practical value.

meaningEN: To make somebody feel separate from a group.
commonMistakes: ❌ alienate مرتبطة بحرف الجر FROM: alienate someone FROM a group.
examples: The policy alienated many young voters.
New staff may feel alienated at first.
A rude tone can alienate customers.
He became increasingly alienated from his family.

meaningEN: A claim that someone has done something wrong.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'allegation' (ادعاء) و'testimonial' (شهادة تقدير) — مختلفان تماماً.
examples: The senator denied the allegations of corruption.
The police are investigating the allegations.
He made a serious allegation against the firm.
The allegation has not been proven in court.

meaningEN: To claim something without proof.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'allege' تحتاج أن يكون معها 'that' أو الجر... ✅ allege that + جملة.
examples: The report alleges widespread abuse.
She alleges that the data was falsified.
The alleged thief was released without charge.
He is alleged to have accepted bribes.

meaningEN: Caring about others more than yourself.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'altruist' (شخص إيثاري) → ✅ الاسم والإملاء: altruistic.
examples: Volunteering is a truly altruistic act.
Her donation came from altruistic motives.
Some scientists study altruistic behaviour in animals.
The praise was purely altruistic in spirit.

meaningEN: To make a bad situation better.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'ameliorate' بمعنى تحسين أوضاع سيئة، وليس 'أكمل' — إملاؤها يحتوي 'lior'.
examples: New policies aim to ameliorate poverty.
Better housing ameliorated working conditions.
Nothing could ameliorate the suffering of the victims.
The aid package only slightly ameliorated the crisis.

meaningEN: Similar in some ways and calling for comparison.
commonMistakes: ❌ analogous TO (وليس with غالباً) — ✅ الاسم analogy.
examples: The situation is analogous to last year's crisis.
A computer is sometimes analogous to a human brain.
They cited an analogous case from history.
The task requires skills analogous to teaching.

meaningEN: To catch a criminal, or to understand something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'apprehend' (قبض/استيعاب) و'apprehensive' (قلق) — إملاء متقارب لكن معانٍ مختلفة.
examples: Police apprehended the suspect at dawn.
Students may fail to apprehend complex theories.
The fugitive managed to avoid apprehension.
I finally apprehended the point of the essay.

meaningEN: Needing a lot of effort and hard work.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'hard' عامة، 'arduous' شاق ومضنٍ — لتفاوت المعنى. النطق /ˈɑːdjuəs/.
examples: The expedition was an arduous journey across ice.
Becoming a doctor involves arduous training.
Reforming the system is an arduous task.
The men endured arduous conditions for weeks.

meaningEN: To express ideas clearly; able to speak clearly.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'articulate' كفعل /ˌɑrˈtɪkjuleɪt/ وكصفة 'واضح البيان' — الصفة تنطق /ɑːˈtɪkjələt/ غالباً.
examples: She articulated her argument clearly.
He is an articulate and confident speaker.
It was hard to articulate the feeling in words.
The report articulates the company's long-term vision.

meaningEN: To find out something for certain.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'ascertain' رسمية = تتأكد من — لا تخلط مع 'certain' (متأكد).
examples: The doctor tried to ascertain the cause of the illness.
Police are ascertaining whether the report is true.
It is difficult to ascertain the exact number.
The committee sought to ascertain the facts first.

meaningEN: To hope to achieve something or aim for it.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'aspire' لا تأخذ مفعولاً مباشراً — ✅ aspire TO something.
examples: She aspires to become a professor.
Many young people aspire to work in tech.
The city aspires to be a global hub.
He is an aspiring novelist with a blog.

meaningEN: Able to understand situations quickly and use them well.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'astute' تعني دهاء الفهم وليس الذكاء العضوي — لا تخلط مع 'brilliant'.
examples: She was an astute observer of markets.
It was an astute move to negotiate early.
The astute investor bought shares before the rally.
He proved astute in handling the crisis.

meaningEN: Very obvious and done without shame.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'blatant' ذو طابع سلبي واضح — لا تستخدمها للأشياء الإيجابية — blatantly (adv.).
examples: The report exposed a blatant attempt to deceive.
It was a blatant violation of the rules.
He lied with blatant disregard for the truth.
The move showed blatant self-interest.

meaningEN: To support or strengthen something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'bolster' (يدعم) والاسم ' bolster' (مخدة طويلة) — نفس الكلمة بمعانٍ مختلفة.
examples: The news bolstered public confidence.
Lower taxes could bolster the economy.
New evidence bolstered the case.
The win bolstered the team's morale.

meaningEN: A warning that there are limits or conditions.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'caveat' تُستخدم غالباً 'with the caveat that' — مذكرة قانونية أصلاً بمعنى تحفظ.
examples: The deal was approved with one caveat.
They added a caveat about rising costs.
I accept the plan, but with a caveat.
The report offers praise with a caveat.

meaningEN: To give up control or territory to someone else.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'cede' (يتنازل) و'cease' (يتوقف) — إملاء متشابه لكن معانٍ مختلفة.
examples: The country ceded part of its territory.
He refused to cede control of the company.
The king ceded power to the parliament.
They were forced to cede the disputed region.

meaningEN: Able to work together or exist together without problems.
commonMistakes: ❌ compatible TO → ✅ compatible WITH.
examples: The printer is compatible with both systems.
Their personal values are completely compatible.
Older phones are not compatible with the new app.
The two machines are designed to be compatible.

meaningEN: A statement saying you are unhappy about something.
commonMistakes: ❌ make a complain → ✅ make a COMPLAINT — 'complain' فعل و'complaint' اسم.
examples: She made a formal complaint about the noise.
The manager listened to every complaint.
His only complaint was the cold weather.
Customers can lodge complaints online.

meaningEN: The way things are arranged, or a piece of writing/music.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'composition' (إنشاء/نسبة مكونات) و'composition' للكتابة الأكاديمية — أكاديمياً تعني مقالة.
examples: The essay asks students to write a composition.
Water's chemical composition is simple.
The composition of the team changed last year.
She performed her own composition on piano.

meaningEN: A substance of two or more elements, or something made of parts.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'compound' كاسم /ˈkɒmpaʊnd/ وكفعل 'يضاعف' يُقرأ أيضاً /kəmˈpaʊnd/.
examples: Salt is a chemical compound.
Banks calculate compound interest annually.
Compound sentences join two simple ideas.
The factory sits inside a large compound.

meaningEN: Worry, or something that you care about.
commonMistakes: ❌ concern TO معانيها... — ✅ The report is concerning (يثير القلق) لكن 'concerned' (قلق).
examples: Safety is a major public concern.
His health causes us great concern.
The new policy is a concern for small firms.
Scientists are concerned about the results.

meaningEN: To decide something using evidence, or to end something.
commonMistakes: ❌ conclude TO... → ✅ conclude THAT + جملة — أو conclude + something.
examples: Researchers concluded that the test was reliable.
The meeting concluded with a short summary.
We can safely conclude the plan has failed.
The two sides concluded a trade agreement.

meaningEN: Specific and definite, not just an idea.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'concrete' لها معنيان: المادي (الخرسانة) والصفة (ملموس/محدد) — انتبه للسياق.
examples: The report gives concrete evidence of improvement.
We need a concrete plan before we start.
The teacher asked for concrete examples.
Take concrete steps to reduce your costs.

meaningEN: A formal meeting for discussion, often over several days.
commonMistakes: ❌ make a conference → ✅ ATTEND / HOLD / HOST a conference.
examples: She presented her research at a conference.
The press conference started on time.
The hotel has conference rooms for hire.
The annual conference attracts 5,000 delegates.

meaningEN: Large in amount, size or importance.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'considerable' (كبير/جوهري) و'considerate' (مراعٍ للآخرين) — معانٍ مختلفة تماماً!
examples: The project required a considerable amount of money.
She spent considerable time on the research.
The company has considerable influence in the market.
There has been considerable progress since then.

meaningEN: To be made of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ consist FROM → ✅ consist OF — 'consist in' = يتمثل في (فكرة مجردة).
examples: Water consists of hydrogen and oxygen.
The course consists of ten modules.
Success consists in doing small things well.
The diet mainly consists of rice and vegetables.

meaningEN: To ask an expert for advice or information.
commonMistakes: ❌ consult TO → ✅ consult someone مباشرة — لكن 'consult with' مقبولة مع أشخاص بشكل رسمي.
examples: You should consult a doctor about the symptoms.
The manager consulted the team before deciding.
Please consult the user manual first.
They consulted with local residents.

meaningEN: The use of food, energy or goods, or the amount used.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'consumption' (اسم) من 'consume' (فعل) — لا تخلط مع 'cost' (تكلفة).
examples: Energy consumption rises in winter.
Measures aim to cut water consumption.
The report tracks food consumption trends.
Excess sugar consumption harms health.

meaningEN: Communication with somebody, or touching something.
commonMistakes: ❌ make contact TO → ✅ CONTACT someone مباشرة (فعل) — make contact WITH (عبارة).
examples: We stayed in contact after the course.
Please contact the office for more details.
The new road improves contact between towns.
Make sure you have her contact details.

meaningEN: A box or other object used to hold things.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'container' (حاوية) و'content' (محتوى) — لا تخلط.
examples: Store the rice in an airtight container.
Goods arrive in large shipping containers.
The package arrived in a plastic container.
Recycle containers after washing them.

meaningEN: To have something inside, or to hold back something.
commonMistakes: ❌ contains OF → ✅ contain(s) + مفعول مباشر (لا حرف جر).
examples: This box contains old photographs.
The report contains key recommendations.
Authorities worked to contain the fire.
The argument contained many contradictions.

meaningEN: The ideas or information in a text or programme.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'content' /ˈkɒntent/ (المحتوى) و'content' /kənˈtent/ (راضٍ) — التمييز نغمة الصوت.
examples: The content of the report is accurate.
Creators produce content for social media.
The book has more exercises than content.
Please review the table of contents first.

meaningEN: A large company or group of companies.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'corporation' (شركة) و'cooperation' (تعاون) — إملاء قريب لكن معنى مختلف.
examples: The corporation employs thousands of workers.
Multinational corporations dominate the market.
Corporate tax rates vary by country.
The corporation funds local schools.

meaningEN: The amount of money needed to buy or do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'cost' (اسم) و 'price' (سعر) و 'charge' (رسوم) — مقيدة السياق معاً.
examples: The cost of living keeps rising.
We must cut costs to survive.
The damage was repaired at great cost.
Solar power is now cost-effective.

meaningEN: Land outside towns and cities, with farms and nature.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'the countryside' (الريف) و'the country' (البلاد/الريف) — كلاهما صالح لكن countryside محددة.
examples: We spent the weekend in the countryside.
The house overlooks beautiful countryside.
People seek fresh air in the countryside.
Policies aim to protect the countryside.

meaningEN: To put something over a surface, or to deal with a topic.
commonMistakes: ❌ cover + مفعول مباشر — ✅ covers several topics (يشمل) — لا تخلط مع 'discover'.
examples: Snow covered the whole valley.
The course covers basic economics.
Insurance covers most of the costs.
The photo is on the front cover.

meaningEN: A serious accident, or a loud sound of impact.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'crash' (حادث/انهيار) و'smash' (يكسر بعنف) — crash أكثرها للسيارات/الأسواق.
examples: Two vehicles were involved in a crash.
The stock market crash wiped out savings.
The plane crashed into the hillside.
My computer crashed twice this morning.

meaningEN: The act of making something new.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'creation' (اسم) و'create' (فعل) — ✅ job creation يشيع في الاقتصاد.
examples: The law supports the creation of new jobs.
Research allows the creation of better medicines.
The artist's latest creation is on display.
Innovation drives the creation of entirely new markets.

meaningEN: The money used in a particular country.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'currency' (عملة) و'money' (مال) — currency رسمية لمفهوم النقود الوطني.
examples: The local currency lost value quickly.
You can buy foreign currency at the bank.
Digital currencies are growing in popularity.
The exchange rate affects trade between countries.

meaningEN: Happening or existing now.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'current' (حالي) و'currently' (ظرف حالي) — ❌ currant (زبيب) إملاء مختلف!
examples: The current situation requires quick action.
Under current rules, this is illegal.
Current events influence exam topics.
The current rate is very competitive.

meaningEN: The subjects and content taught in a school or course.
commonMistakes: ❌ جمعها 'curricula' وليس 'curriculums' فقط — ✅ curricula (الأشيع) وcurriculums مقبول أيضاً.
examples: The national curriculum includes science and maths.
Schools review the curriculum every five years.
Teachers were consulted on curriculum design.
The new curriculum emphasises practical skills.

meaningEN: A period of ten years.
commonMistakes: ❌ نطقها /ˈdekeɪd/ في معظم السياقات — /dɪˈkeɪd/ أقل شيوعاً.
examples: Over the past decade, prices have doubled.
She has decades of teaching experience.
The city changed greatly in one decade.
The country was at peace for decades.

meaningEN: To win against somebody, or a loss in a contest.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'defeat' (يهزم) بمعنيي المنافسات والغرض — 'defeat the purpose' أسلوب شائع.
examples: The home team defeated their rivals 3-1.
They suffered a heavy defeat in the final.
The plan would defeat the purpose of the law.
She refused to admit defeat.

meaningEN: An exact explanation of what a word or idea means.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'definition' (تعريف) و'description' (وصف) — تعريف يعطي الحد النهائي، وصف يفصّل.
examples: The essay begins with a clear definition.
By definition, a triangle has three sides.
Definitions of success vary from person to person.
The dictionary gives simple definitions.

meaningEN: To remove parts of a book, film or news that are not allowed.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'censor' (يرقيب) و'sensor' (جهاز استشعار) و'censure' (يوبخ) — ثلاث كلمات متقاربة الإملاء!
examples: The film was heavily censored abroad.
Officials censored parts of the broadcast.
Journalists protested the censored report.
The board acted as censor of all publications.

meaningEN: To force somebody to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'coerce' (يجبر) و'coercion' (اسم) و'coercive' (صفة) — ✅ coerce someone INTO doing.
examples: Workers were coerced into signing the contract.
No one should be coerced into voting.
The court rejected the coerced confession.
They refused to be coerced by threats.

meaningEN: Matching in size, degree or value; proportional.
commonMistakes: ❌ نطقها /kəˈmenʃərət/ — لم تمدد 'men'. ✅ commensurate WITH (وليس to غالباً).
examples: The salary is commensurate with experience.
Her wages are not commensurate with her role.
Success should be commensurate with effort.
The penalty was commensurate with the offence.

meaningEN: To force somebody to do something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'compel' و'compelling' (مقنع بشدة... كصفة) — الفروق الدقيقة مهمة.
examples: The law compels drivers to wear seat belts.
She felt compelled to tell the truth.
Budget cuts compelled the library to close early.
The evidence compels a different conclusion.

meaningEN: To add something that makes another thing complete or better.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'complement' (يُكمّل) و'compliment' (مجاملة) — إملاء قريب لكن معانٍ مختلفة تماماً!
examples: The two teachers complement each other well.
Wine complements the flavour of the dish.
The partners bring complementary skills.
Her calm style is a perfect complement to his energy.

meaningEN: Required by rule or law; not optional.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'compulsory' (إجباري) و'voluntary' (طوعي) متضادان — دائماً للتأكيد على التباين.
examples: Education is compulsory until the age of 16.
Attendance at the seminar is compulsory.
The new law makes helmets compulsory.
Registration for the course is compulsory.

meaningEN: To think of a new idea, or to imagine something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'conceive' (يتصور/يبتكر) و'concede' (يعترف/يتنازل) و'conceive' للطب (يحمل) — راجع السياق.
examples: The design was conceived by young engineers.
It is hard to conceive of life without water.
She conceived the idea during a flight.
The policy was poorly conceived from the start.

meaningEN: To agree with somebody or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ concur TO → ✅ concur WITH someone/something — ويمكن concur with the view/opinion.
examples: Most experts concur with this conclusion.
The judges concurred that the essay was best.
I fully concur with your assessment.
The committee concurred after brief debate.

meaningEN: To accept or allow behaviour that is wrong.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'condone' (يتسامح مع الخطأ) و'condemn' (يدين) — متضادان!
examples: The school does not condone cheating.
Violence should never be condoned.
Silence can be seen as condoning the act.
Many refuse to condone the new rules.

meaningEN: An idea or feeling a word suggests beyond its meaning.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'connotation' (دلالة ضمنية) و'denotation' (معنى حرفي) — مصطلحان لغويان متقابلان.
examples: The word 'home' has warm connotations.
This term carries strong negative connotations.
Writers use connotations to create feeling.
The connotation of the slogan disappointed fans.

meaningEN: Careful and responsible in your work.
commonMistakes: ❌ نطقها وكذا إملاء: انتبه للـ 'sci' — ليس 'consious'. و 'conscience' (ضمير) مصطلح قريب.
examples: She is a conscientious and reliable worker.
Conscientious students check their work twice.
He is very conscientious about deadlines.
The report reflects conscientious research.

meaningEN: Following one after another without a break.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'consecutive' (متتابع) و'successive' (تعاقب للحكام/السنين) — قرب المعنى لكن استخدم الرقم قبل consecutive غالباً.
examples: It rained for five consecutive days.
The team won four consecutive matches.
This is his third consecutive award.
Sales fell for the second consecutive year.

meaningEN: Against rapid change; cautious and traditional.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'conservative' (محافظ) لا تُخلط مع 'conservation' (حماية البيئة/التراث).
examples: Even a conservative estimate puts costs high.
The town holds conservative values.
Investors took a conservative approach.
She prefers conservative clothing.

meaningEN: A secret plan by a group to do something illegal.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'conspiracy' (جمع conspiracies) — الفعل 'conspire against' — لا تخلط مع 'convergence'.
examples: He was charged with conspiracy to defraud.
Many believe in a global conspiracy theory.
The film uncovers a political conspiracy.
The three conspired against the director.

meaningEN: To argue a point, or to compete for something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'contend' (يدّعي/ينافس) و'content' (المحتوى) — حروف متقاربة، معانٍ مختلفة.
examples: The report contends that funding is insufficient.
Farmers contend with unpredictable weather.
Three teams contend for the title.
She contended that the test was unfair.

meaningEN: A strong feeling of disgust or disrespect.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'contempt' (ازدراء) و'content' — إملاء: كن حذراً مع الحرف 'e' والنطق /kənˈtempt/.
examples: He showed contempt for the rules.
The remark was treated with contempt.
The lawyer faced contempt of court.
Her eyes were full of contempt.

meaningEN: Causing argument or disagreement.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'contentious' (مثير للجدل) و'content' (محتوى) و'contemptuous' (ازدرائي) — ثلاث كلمات متشابهة!
examples: Tax reform remains a contentious issue.
The plan is highly contentious among residents.
The debate became increasingly contentious.
Few topics are as contentious as education policy.

meaningEN: Opposite in nature or completely different.
collocations: unless you hear to the contrary
commonMistakes: ❌ 'contrary to' ≠ 'on the contrary' — الأول = مخالفٌ لـ، والثاني = بل على العكس.
examples: Contrary to expectations, sales increased.
On the contrary, I found the task easy.
The evidence is contrary to the claim.
He did nothing contrary to the law.

meaningEN: To come together for a formal meeting.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'convene' (يجتمع) وتدجين المعنى: convene a meeting؛ لا تخلط مع 'convention'.
examples: The board convened a special meeting.
Delegates convene in Geneva each year.
The committee convened to review the plan.
The conference was convened by the ministry.

meaningEN: To come together from different directions.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'converge' (يلتقي) و'diverge' (ينفصل) متضادان — وتنطق بحرف g ناعم.
examples: Thousands of fans converged on the stadium.
The two roads converge near the bridge.
Their views gradually converged during the talks.
Streams converge into a single river.

meaningEN: A university qualification, or a level of something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'degree in' = تخصص علمي / 'degree of' = مستوى — لا تخلط To a degree = إلى حدٍ ما.
examples: She has a degree in engineering.
The plan requires a high degree of coordination.
To some degree, the test is about time management.
Many employers now expect a university degree.

meaningEN: A section of a large organisation.
commonMistakes: ❌ إملاء: department تنتهي بـ -ment وليس -mint. الاختصار الشائع 'dept.'
examples: She works in the marketing department.
The HR department handles all hiring.
He was promoted to head of department.
The department store sells everything.

meaningEN: A sum of money paid as part of a price, or money placed in a bank.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'deposit' (وديعة/دفعة) و'withdrawal' (سحب) متضادان في السياق البنكي.
examples: They paid a deposit to reserve the flat.
I made a deposit into my savings account.
The hotel asks for a refundable deposit.
Deposits of salt formed across the plain.

meaningEN: A dry land covered mostly with sand.
collocations: in the middle of the desert
commonMistakes: ❌ 'desert' /ˈdezət/ (صحراء) و'desert' /dɪˈzɜːt/ (يهجر) و'dessert' /dɪˈzɜːt/ (حلوى) — نطق وإملاء مختلفان!
examples: Camels survive in the driest deserts.
The caravan crossed the desert at night.
Few plants grow in the harsh desert climate.
Water is the most precious resource in the desert.

meaningEN: To be worth having or getting something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'deserve' لا تُستخدم بصيغة مستمرة عادةً — ✅ He deserves (وليس is deserving it).
examples: You deserve a rest after all that work.
The issue deserves urgent attention.
Her win was fully deserved.
Everyone deserves a fair chance.

meaningEN: A machine or tool for a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'device' (اسم) و'devise' (فعل = يبتكر) — إملاء قريب ومعنى مختلف.
examples: Turn off all electronic devices during take-off.
The safety device stops the machine automatically.
She wears a device that measures her steps.
The app works on any modern device.

meaningEN: A simple drawing that explains how something works.
commonMistakes: ❌ إملاء: diagram (وليس digram) — جمعه diagrams.
examples: The manual includes a diagram of the engine.
Draw a diagram to show the process.
The label on the diagram explains each part.
The diagram shows how water is recycled.

meaningEN: A conversation between people, especially for discussion.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'dialogue' (حوار) و'conversation' (محادثة قصيرة) — dialogue يوحي بجدية/تبادل رسمي.
examples: The two sides opened a constructive dialogue.
The play is built on sharp dialogue.
Teachers encourage dialogue between students.
A real dialogue requires honest listening.

meaningEN: To be different from something or someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ differ FROM (وليس of/than) — ❌ 'different' صفة و'differ' فعل.
examples: Prices differ from one shop to another.
Opinions differ on how to solve the problem.
The two models differ in size and price.
Results differ widely across regions.

meaningEN: The state of being hard to do, or a problem.
commonMistakes: ❌ difficulty TO do → ✅ difficulty IN doing / difficulty doing — جمعها difficulties.
examples: She had difficulty concentrating in class.
The project faced many difficulties.
He climbed the stairs with difficulty.
Language difficulty discouraged some applicants.

meaningEN: Using computer technology or electronic signals.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'digital' (رقمي) و'online' (متصل) — digital تعني شكل الإشارة ونمطها.
examples: The museum offers a digital tour.
Digital payment is now common everywhere.
Students need strong digital skills.
We live in the digital age.

meaningEN: A sudden terrible event that causes great damage.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'disaster' (كارثة) و'disastrous' (صفة) — إملاء: disasters / disastrous.
examples: Earthquakes are among the worst natural disasters.
The party ended in disaster.
Emergency teams arrived at the disaster area.
Poor planning turned the event into a disaster.

meaningEN: The practice of following rules, or an academic subject.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'discipline' (انضباط/تخصص) و'punishment' (عقوبة) — ليست مرادفاً لها.
examples: Success in sport requires self-discipline.
The teacher maintained strict discipline.
Psychology is a fascinating academic discipline.
She studies within the discipline of economics.

meaningEN: A reduction in the usual price.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'discount' (تخفيض) معناه كلمة قريبة من 'deal' — الفعل/الاسم يقرأ /ˈdɪskaʊnt/ عادةً.
examples: Students get a 20% discount on tickets.
The store offered a discount on all shoes.
I bought it at a discount during the sale.
Members receive a special discount.

meaningEN: An illness that affects the body or mind.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'disease' (مرض) و'illness' (مرض/اعتلال) و'sickness' (إعياء) — قريبة المعنى لكن disease طبية وأشمل.
examples: Exercise lowers the risk of heart disease.
New vaccines fight infectious diseases.
Clean water helps prevent disease.
The disease spreads quickly in crowded areas.

meaningEN: To reject an idea, or to send someone away from a job.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'dismiss' (يرفض/يفصل) و'disband' (يحل جمعاً) — منفصلان. و'be dismissed from' = يفصل من.
examples: The court dismissed the claim.
She dismissed the idea as impossible.
He was dismissed from his job last month.
Don't dismiss the evidence too quickly.

meaningEN: To show something for people to see.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'display' (يعرض) و'deploy' (ينشر آلياً) — معانٍ مختلفة رغم القرب.
examples: The museum displays ancient coins.
The price is displayed on the screen.
The awards were on display in the lobby.
Her work demonstrates a clear display of skill.

meaningEN: The amount of space between two places.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'distance' (مسافة) و'distant' (بعيد) — ❌ a far distance → ✅ a long distance.
examples: What is the distance between the two cities?
The beach is within walking distance.
She spotted him at a distance.
Long-distance running builds endurance.

meaningEN: An area of a town or country with a particular purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'district' (حي/منطقة) و'region' (إقليم) و'area' (منطقة عامة) — district إدارية.
examples: She lives in a quiet residential district.
The business district is busy all day.
Each district elects its own council.
The library serves the whole district.

meaningEN: The act of dividing or sharing, or a part of a company.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'division' (قسم) و'department' (إدارة) و'divide' (فعل) — لا تخلط مع 'vision'.
examples: She leads the research division.
A clear division of labour helped the team.
The issue caused a division among members.
Division is taught after multiplication.

meaningEN: An official paper or electronic file.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'document' (اسم) و'documentary' (فيلم وثائقي) — الاسم من يميز نفس الكلمة للملفات.
examples: Please bring the required documents.
The contract is an important legal document.
Researchers documented every step of the study.
Save the document before closing the app.

meaningEN: To give something, especially money, to help others.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'donate' و'donation' (اسم) و'donor' (متبرع) — Donate money to a cause.
examples: She donated $500 to the hospital fund.
Volunteers encourage people to donate blood.
Old clothes are donated to families in need.
The charity thanked every donor.

meaningEN: Twice the amount, or a room/bed for two.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'double' (ضعفان) و'twice' (مرتين) — ✅ twice as much / double the amount.
examples: Costs have doubled in five years.
We booked a room with a double bed.
Always double-check your answers.
Sales reached double figures for the first time.

meaningEN: Expected to happen, or owed at a particular time.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'due to' = بسبب (وليس 'because of' دائماً بالشكل نفسه) — ✅ The delay was due to rain.
examples: The report is due on Friday.
The baby is due in March.
The crash was due to heavy fog.
You will receive a reply in due course.

meaningEN: A formal request, or the use of an idea in real life.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'application' (طلب/تطبيق) و'apply' (فعل) — ✅ apply for a job / submit an application.
examples: Her application for the job was successful.
Fill in the application form online.
The application of new methods saved time.
This mobile application helps you study.

meaningEN: Using or producing electricity.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'electric' (يعمل بالكهرباء/يولّدها) و'electrical' (متصل بالكهرباء) — electric car/ electric field؛ electrical engineering.
examples: Electric cars produce no exhaust fumes.
The storm cut electric power in the area.
He received a minor electric shock.
Electric heating is efficient in small rooms.

meaningEN: A person who is paid to work for someone or a company.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'employee' (موظف) و'employer' (صاحب العمل) — من يدفع هو employer، الذي يدفع له employee.
examples: The company has 500 employees.
Employee benefits include health insurance.
She is a loyal and experienced employee.
Employers value honest employees.

meaningEN: A strong belief, or a decision that someone is guilty.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'conviction' (يقين/إدانة) و'convince' (يقنع) — إدانة قضائية أيضاً.
examples: She spoke with deep conviction.
The campaign was driven by moral conviction.
He has a prior conviction for theft.
The appeal overturned the conviction.

meaningEN: To make somebody believe something is true.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'convince' (يقنع بالصحة) و'persuade' (يدفع للفعل) — متقاربان لكن subtle difference.
examples: She convinced me that the idea would work.
He convinced his parents to let him travel.
I am convinced of her honesty.
