The evidence convinced most of the jury.

meaningEN: To act against something to reduce its effect.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'counteract' (يؤثر ضد) و'contract' (عقد) — لا تخلط المعاني.
examples: Exercise helps counteract the effects of stress.
The drug counteracts the poison.
New measures counteract rising costs.
Recycling counteracts some of the damage.

meaningEN: Heavy, large or slow, and difficult to handle.
commonMistakes: ❌ نطقها بمقاطع: cum-ber-some /ˈkʌmbəsəm/ — ثلاثية المقاطع وليس بالقسط.
examples: Old equipment is heavy and cumbersome.
The visa process feels slow and cumbersome.
They replaced the cumbersome filing system.
Carrying the gear was cumbersome.

meaningEN: Believing that people act only for selfish reasons.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'cynical' (متشائم من النوايا) و'skeptical' (مشكك بالأدلة) و'pessimistic' (متشائم) — ثلاثة معانٍ مختلفة.
examples: He has a cynical view of advertising.
Many voters have become cynical about politics.
Her cynical remark silenced the room.
The team stayed positive despite the cynical critics.

meaningEN: To refuse to obey someone or something.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'defy' (يتحدى) و'defy' لا ترتبط بـ 'defeat' — راجع الفرق: defy=يتحدى، defeat=يهزم.
examples: The athletes defied the odds to win.
She defied her parents and moved abroad.
The protest defied the government's order.
His behaviour defies explanation.

meaningEN: To hate something very much.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'abhor' بمعنى يكره أخلاقاً — لا تخلط مع 'abhorrent' (صفة) و'abhors' (تصريف).
examples: She abhors any form of violence.
He abhors being late for meetings.
The public abhors such cruel treatment.
Many citizens abhor the very idea of censorship.

meaningEN: Kind, helpful and generous.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'benevolent' (خير) و'beneficial' (مفيد) — صفتان مختلفتان.
examples: The benevolent old man gave money to the poor.
She runs a benevolent society for retired nurses.
His benevolent manner put patients at ease.
The grant came from a benevolent donor.

meaningEN: A confusing and difficult problem or question.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'conundrum' (لغز/معضلة) و'quandary' (حيرة) — قريبا المعنى؛ conundrum قد يكون ألغازياً.
examples: The case presents a difficult conundrum.
Scientists face a fascinating conundrum.
Funding cuts create a policy conundrum.
The riddle was a classic conundrum.

meaningEN: A division between two completely opposite things.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'dichotomy' (انقسام ثنائي) و'dilemma' (ورطة باختيارين) — ليست نفس المعنى.
examples: The essay discusses the dichotomy between mind and body.
It is a false dichotomy to choose one or the other.
The study shows a clear dichotomy in results.
Language reflects the dichotomy between old and new.

meaningEN: Very different from each other; of different kinds.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'disparate' (متباين) و'desperate' (يائس) — إملاء قريب معنى بعيد. نطقها dis-pa-rat.
examples: The course brings together disparate disciplines.
People came from widely disparate backgrounds.
The team combines disparate skills.
Data from disparate sources must be reconciled.

meaningEN: Able to express ideas clearly and well.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'eloquent' (فصيح في الكلام) و'fluent' (طلِق بلا توقف) — fluency طلاقة وeloquence بلاغة.
examples: She gave an eloquent speech at the ceremony.
His eloquent reply impressed the judges.
The writer is eloquent about rural life.
Few leaders were as eloquent as her.

meaningEN: Having great knowledge from reading and study.
commonMistakes: ❌ نطقها المعمول به /ˈerudaɪt/ — لا تشدّد الحرفين بشكل غير طبيعي.
examples: The professor is an erudite historian.
His erudite lecture drew a full hall.
She gave an erudite analysis of the poem.
The journal values erudite reviews.

meaningEN: To make something unclear or confusing on purpose.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'obfuscate' (يغيّم عمداً) و'obscure' (يخفي/غامض) — obfuscate فعل متعدٍ بمعنى يحجب عمداً.
examples: The company tried to obfuscate the loss.
Legal language can obfuscate simple rules.
He obfuscated the facts during the trial.
Clear charts help avoid obfuscating the data.

meaningEN: Something that solves every problem.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'panacea' (حل لكل شيء) و'cure-all' — تُنكر عادة: 'no panacea for...'.
examples: Technology is not a panacea for inequality.
They treated the new law as a panacea.
There is no single panacea for poverty.
The drug was hailed as a medical panacea.

meaningEN: Refusing to obey rules or follow orders.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'recalcitrant' تعني المتمرد/الصعب — انتبه للإملاء: r-e-c-a-l-c-i-t-r-a-n-t.
examples: The teacher struggled with recalcitrant pupils.
Officials failed to change his recalcitrant stance.
A recalcitrant member refused to sign.
The horse was calm but proved recalcitrant at the gate.

meaningEN: Understood or agreed without being said openly.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'tacit' (ضمني) و'tactic' (خطة/تكتيك) و'tact' (لباقة) — ثلاث كلمات متشابهة الإملاء.
examples: The two sides reached a tacit agreement.
Her silence was taken as tacit approval.
Experienced workers hold tacit knowledge.
The family had a tacit rule against gossip.

meaningEN: Determined and not giving up easily.
commonMistakes: ❌ 'tenacious' (عنيد في المثابرة) و'obstinate' (عنيد سلبياً) — tenacious إيجابي غالباً.
examples: She is a tenacious defender of the cause.
His tenacious memory helped him in exams.
The climbing team remained tenacious to the summit.
Species survive because of tenacious adaptation.

meaningEN: A place where planes take off and land.
commonMistakes: ❌ نقول at the airport وليس in the airport عند التحديد الدقيق.
❌ لا تخلط airport مع seaport (ميناء بحري).
examples: We arrived at the airport two hours early.
The airport is north of the city.
She missed her flight at the airport.
A new international airport opened last year.

meaningEN: A living creature that is not a plant or a human.
commonMistakes: ❌ animal يشمل ما عدا الإنسان؛ لا تقل human animal سوى مجازاً.
❌ صفة الحيوان هي animal، وليست animalistic (وحشي).
examples: Lions are wild animals.
Many animals live in this forest.
She loves small animals like cats and dogs.
The zoo has animals from around the world.

meaningEN: A round fruit with red or green skin and white inside.
commonMistakes: ❌ لا نضيف s للجمع مع أدوات العدد: two apple SO خاطئة والصحيح two apples.
❌ apple تُنطق /ˈæpəl/ وليس /ˈeɪpəl/.
examples: She ate an apple for breakfast.
These apples are from the local farm.
An apple a day keeps the doctor away.
He cut the apple into four pieces.

meaningEN: A period of time when someone teaches you something.
commonMistakes: ❌ لا تخلط lesson (درس) مع listener (مستمع).
❌ بعد learn a lesson لا نضيف من: learn a lesson FROM experience وليس of.
examples: I have a music lesson on Fridays.
The lesson was about global warming.
She gave him a driving lesson.
This failure taught me a valuable lesson.

meaningEN: The brightness that lets you see; not heavy or dark.
commonMistakes: ❌ light كفعل ماضيه lit وليس light-ed، لكن lighted تصح مع المفعول: a lighted candle.
❌ لا تخلط light (ضوء) مع slight (طفيف).
examples: The light in this room is too bright.
This bag is very light to carry.
It gets dark when the light fades.
She wears light colours in summer.

meaningEN: A meal eaten in the middle of the day.
commonMistakes: ❌ نقول have lunch (بلا the) عادة، وhave the lunch فقط إن كانت محدداً.
❌ هناك خطأ شائع: lunch منظوقة /lʌntʃ/ وليس /lunːʃ/.
examples: We have lunch at one o'clock.
She packed a lunch for school.
Let's meet for lunch tomorrow.
I had a quick lunch near the office.

meaningEN: A place where goods are bought and sold; to sell or promote.
commonMistakes: ❌ on the market (متوفر للبيع) وin the market FOR something (يريد شراءه) — لا تخلطا.
❌ جذر فعل market خاطئ: to market (يسوق) وليس to marketing.
examples: She buys vegetables at the market.
The company will market the new phone abroad.
The farmers' market opens on Saturdays.
Housing prices fell in the market.

meaningEN: A white liquid from cows or other animals; to take milk from.
commonMistakes: ❌ الاسم milk لا يجمع مطلقاً؛ قل two glasses of milk.
❌ لا تخلط milk (حليب) مع silk (حرير).
examples: He drinks a glass of milk every morning.
The farmer milks the cows at dawn.
Milk is rich in calcium.
Add a little milk to the tea.

meaningEN: The time when it is dark and most people sleep.
commonMistakes: ❌ at night لا تحتاج للدلالة على العلامة: نقول at night وليس at the night.
❌ لا تخلط night مع knight (فارس) في الكتابة.
examples: The stars are bright at night.
We stayed up all night talking.
She has trouble sleeping at night.
The meeting was cancelled at night.

meaningEN: A word or symbol that shows how many; to give a number.
commonMistakes: ❌ a number of + جمع (عدة) وthe number of + مفرد (العدد) — قواعد مختلفة.
❌ لا تخلط number مع amount: number للأشياء المعدودة.
examples: What is your phone number?
Please write your seat number.
The number of students is growing.
We numbered the pages in order.

meaningEN: Water falling from clouds; to fall as rain.
commonMistakes: ❌ rain اسم غير معدود: قل lots of rain وليس many rains (رغم جواز rains جمعاً أدبياً).
❌ It rains لا نقول it is rainy كفعل (rainy صفة).
examples: The rain started at noon.
It often rains in autumn.
We got caught in the rain.
Heavy rain flooded the roads.

meaningEN: A place where you buy things; to buy things.
commonMistakes: ❌ go shopping (تسوّق) وgo to the shops (تذهب إلى المتاجر) — لا تستبدلا.
❌ shop اسم/فعل؛ المتجر الإنجليزي قد نقول store لكن عبارة shop شائعة.
examples: She works in a clothes shop.
We shop for groceries every week.
The shop closes at nine.
He shops online for electronics.

meaningEN: A hot drink made by pouring boiled water over dried leaves.
commonMistakes: ❌ tea غير معدودة: قل a cup of tea وليس a tea إلّا عند طلبه كمشروب في المقهى (a tea صح في السياق).
❌ لا تخلط tea (شاي) مع tee (كرات الغولف).
examples: Would you like a cup of tea?
She drinks green tea after meals.
Tea is popular in Britain.
We had tea and biscuits at four.

meaningEN: To move on foot; a journey on foot.
commonMistakes: ❌ go for a walk وليس go for walk؛ تأتي a.
❌ walk فعل متعدٍ/لازم: walk the dog (متعدٍ) وwalk to work (لازم).
examples: They walk to school every day.
We went for a long walk by the river.
She walks quickly in the mornings.
The walk took us an hour.

meaningEN: The coldest season of the year.
commonMistakes: ❌ in (the) winter وليس on winter — مع الفصول نستخدم in.
❌ لا تخلط winter مع winner في النطق/الإملاء.
examples: It snows here in winter.
Winter in this country is very cold.
They go skiing every winter.
The plants die in winter.

meaningEN: The total amount or result of adding numbers; to add up.
commonMistakes: ❌ a sum of money (مبلغ) وno sum في الرياضيات؛ قل the sum of the numbers.
❌ لا تخلط sum (مجموع) مع some.
examples: The sum of 5 and 7 is 12.
A large sum of money was missing.
The teacher asked us to calculate the sum.
These facts sum up the situation well.

meaningEN: To help someone or hold something up; help given to someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ to support وليس to support with — الفعل متعدٍ مباشرة.
❌ لا تخلط support مع suppose (يفترض).
examples: My family supports my decision.
These beams support the roof.
She offered emotional support to her friend.
The team received great support from fans.

meaningEN: To change from one thing to another; a control for turning on/off.
commonMistakes: ❌ switch on/off تفصل فعل المصدر: switch the light on وليس switch-on the light.
❌ لا تخلط switch مع swap (مبادلة غير رسمية).
examples: Can you switch the light on?
She switched from coffee to tea.
Press the switch to start the machine.
They switched seats so he could see.

meaningEN: A set of connected parts that work together.
commonMistakes: ❌ system تُنطق /ˈsɪstəm/ وليس /ˈsɪsteɪm/.
❌ لا تخلط system (نظام) مع symptom (عَرَض/أعراض مرض).
examples: The education system needs reform.
Solar panels are part of the energy system.
We use a tracking system at work.
The body's immune system fights disease.

meaningEN: How hot or cold something is.
commonMistakes: ❌ تُنطق /ˈtemprətʃə/ (مقطعان عملياً) وليس /tem-pra-tu-re/.
❌ نقول high/low temperature وليس hot/cold temperature.
examples: The temperature rose to 40 degrees.
Check the water temperature before bathing.
She has a high temperature today.
Temperatures fall sharply at night.

meaningEN: Very bad or making you feel upset/frightened.
commonMistakes: ❌ terrible تعني فظيع غالباً وليس «مخيف» حصرياً؛ scary للخوف.
❌ لا تخلط terrible مع terrific (رائع — عكس المعنى!).
examples: The weather was terrible yesterday.
I have a terrible headache.
The film got terrible reviews.
It's a terrible loss for the team.

meaningEN: A subject that people talk or write about.
commonMistakes: ❌ topic وsubject مترادفان لكن topic للمناقشات وsubject للدراسة غالباً.
❌ لا تخلط topic مع tropic (الاستوائي).
examples: The main topic of the meeting was safety.
She chose climate change as her essay topic.
We discussed various topics at lunch.
That topic is too sensitive to ignore.

meaningEN: The whole amount; complete; to add up to.
commonMistakes: ❌ in total (في المجمل) وtotally (تماماً) معناهما مختلفان وتعاملهما مع الجملة مختلف.
❌ لا تخلط total (إجمالي) مع totality (مجموعة كلية).
examples: The total cost was 200 dollars.
The bill totals thirty pounds.
His total earnings last year were high.
There was total silence in the room.

meaningEN: To put your hand on something; the sense of feeling.
commonMistakes: ❌ out of touch مع + with (منفصل عن الواقع) وليس من.
❌ لا تخلط touch مع teach في النطق.
examples: Don't touch the wet paint.
She touched his arm gently.
The story touched everyone's heart.
Keep in touch with me.

meaningEN: The business of people travelling for pleasure.
commonMistakes: ❌ tourism اسم للصناعة؛ the tourist (السائح) للشخص.
❌ لا تخلط tourism مع tour (جولة).
examples: Tourism is the main source of income here.
The island depends heavily on tourism.
Eco-tourism is growing worldwide.
Tourism creates many local jobs.

meaningEN: Cars and other vehicles moving on roads.
commonMistakes: ❌ traffic غير معدودة: قل a lot of traffic وليس many traffics.
❌ traffic lights (إشارات) وtraffic jam (ازدحام) مصطلحان مختلفان.
examples: The traffic is terrible in the morning.
Traffic accidents cause delays.
We got stuck in heavy traffic.
Traffic on the motorway is light today.

meaningEN: The process of learning skills for a job or sport.
commonMistakes: ❌ on-the-job training (تدريب أثناء العمل) وtraining قابل للعد عند الدورات: two trainings مقبولة في بعض السياقات.
❌ لا تخلط training مع trip? بل مع travelling.
examples: She received training in customer service.
The company offers free training courses.
He is doing weight training at the gym.
Training should be practical, not just theoretical.

meaningEN: To change words from one language into another.
commonMistakes: ❌ to translate وليس translate to في أغلب السياقات؛ translate something INTO a language.
❌ لا تخلط translate مع interpret (ترجمة فورية شفهية غالباً).
examples: She translated the letter into French.
This app can translate text instantly.
The novel has been translated into many languages.
He translated the report word for word.

meaningEN: The act or result of changing words into another language.
commonMistakes: ❌ لا تخلط translation مع transliteration (تحويل صوتي/كتابي).
❌ من الوقت إلى: from English INTO Arabic نستخدم into.
examples: The translation is faithful to the original.
We need a better translation of this text.
Literal translation can be misleading.
She compared the English translation with the Arabic.

meaningEN: To carry goods or people; the moving of things.
commonMistakes: ❌ النطق: الفعل /trænˈspɔːt/ والاسم /ˈtrænspɔːt/ في الإنجليزية البريطانية لكن سياق المركبات واحد.
❌ transport في أمريكا يُستعمل كاسم والفعل أيضاً؛ انتظر السياق (مواصلات جماعية vs. نقل).
examples: Lorries transport goods across the country.
Public transport is cheap here.
The goods are in transport now.
They transport passengers by train.

meaningEN: Medical care for an illness; the way someone is treated.
commonMistakes: ❌ treatment for (مرض) وليس treatment of في السياق الطبي.
❌ لا تخلط treatment مع treaty (معاهدة).
examples: She is receiving treatment for her condition.
Fair treatment of workers matters.
The new treatment shows promising results.
His treatment of the students was harsh.

meaningEN: Difficulty or problems; to make someone worried.
commonMistakes: ❌ have trouble DOING شيء وليس have trouble TO do.
❌ trouble مع جذر: trouble sb (يزعج) وdisturb قريبة لكن trouble أخف.
examples: He is having trouble with his car.
Sorry to trouble you late at night.
The project ran into trouble.
She got into trouble at school.

meaningEN: To believe that someone is honest; strong belief in someone.
commonMistakes: ❌ trust جذر مباشر؛ to trust in (يثق تماماً) فقط ديني/قديم.
❌ لا تخلط trust (ثقة) مع truth (حقيقة).
examples: I trust her completely.
Trust is the basis of friendship.
You can trust him with your money.
The public has little trust in politicians.

meaningEN: The true facts about something.
commonMistakes: ❌ صفة truth هي true وليس truthy في الحديث العادي.
❌ لا تخلط truth مع trust (ثقة) وtreat (يعامل).
examples: The truth is rarely simple.
She told him the whole truth.
The report contains some truth.
He promised to tell the truth.

meaningEN: An organisation of workers; the action of joining together.
commonMistakes: ❌ تُنطق /ˈjuːniən/ وليس /ˈjuːnjən/ بشكل خاطئ في بعض اللهجات.
❌ لا تخلط union (اتحاد) مع onion (بصل).
examples: The union demanded higher wages.
The workers joined the union last year.
Their union created a strong team.
The trade union called a strike.

meaningEN: Sad or worried because of something bad; to make someone unhappy.
commonMistakes: ❌ upset كصفة: be upset about sth؛ كفعل ماضيه ومصدره upset (نفس الشكل).
❌ upset بالتركيز على المقطع الثاني في الفعل /ʌpˈset/ والصفة كذلك.
examples: She was upset about the news.
The result upset the whole team.
Don't upset yourself over small things.
He looked upset after the call.

meaningEN: Happening most of the time; normal.
commonMistakes: ❌ as usual (كالعادة) وthan usual (عن المعتاد) — ثبّت التعبيرين.
❌ النطق /ˈjuːʒuəl/ وليس /ˈjuːsuəl/.
examples: This is the usual way of doing it.
He arrived later than usual.
The usual suspects were absent.
Tea is her usual drink.

meaningEN: A long period of free time away from work or school.
commonMistakes: ❌ على vacation بريطاني غالباً holiday؛ كلاهما صحيح لكن اختر واحداً باستمرار.
❌ لا تخلط vacation مع vocation (مهنة).
examples: We went to the beach on vacation.
The summer vacation lasts two months.
She is on vacation this week.
He saved money for a vacation abroad.

meaningEN: A number of different types; the quality of being different.
commonMistakes: ❌ a variety of + جمع: a variety of topics وليس topic غالباً.
❌ تُنطق /vəˈraɪəti/ وليس /ˈværiːəti/.
examples: The shop sells a variety of cheeses.
Variety is important in a balanced diet.
She enjoys the variety of her work.
There are a variety of opinions on this.

meaningEN: Several different types.
commonMistakes: ❌ various تعني عدة مختلفين، لا تُستخدم مع كميات تقديرية: various people صحيحة.
❌ لا تخلط various مع variable (متغير).
examples: The book covers various topics.
We discussed various options.
Various people offered help.
The museum has various exhibits.

meaningEN: A small group of houses in a country area.
commonMistakes: ❌ village tipهو مجموعة بيوت صغيرة؛ town أكبر city أكبر.
❌ لا تخلط village مع vintage (عتيق).
examples: They moved to a quiet village.
The village has no bank.
She grew up in a mountain village.
The whole village came to the festival.

meaningEN: Behaviour that hurts people or damages things.
commonMistakes: ❌ violence اسم غير معدود: a lot of violence وليس violences.
❌ لا تخلط violence مع violation (انتهاك).
examples: Violence on screen can shape attitudes.
The police reported an increase in violence.
He rejects all forms of violence.
The demonstration ended in violence.

meaningEN: Using force that hurts people or damages things.
commonMistakes: ❌ صفة من violence: violent وليس violental.
❌ لا تخلط violent مع violated (مخالف/منتهك).
examples: The film contains violent scenes.
He became violent during the argument.
Violent storms hit the coast.
They were jailed for violent behaviour.

meaningEN: The sound you make when speaking or singing; to express.
commonMistakes: ❌ raise your voice (ترفع صوتك) وlose your voice (تفقد صوتك) - معنيان مختلفان.
❌ لا تخلط voice مع noise (ضوضاء).
examples: She has a beautiful voice.
He raised his voice in anger.
People voiced their concerns at the meeting.
Her voice was clear and calm.

meaningEN: To choose someone or something in an election; a choice made.
commonMistakes: ❌ to vote FOR someone (لسوء) وليس vote someone إلا في سياق مميز (vote him out).
❌ لا تخلط vote مع note (ملاحظة).
examples: Did you vote in the election?
The vote was nearly equal.
She voted for the new candidate.
The board took a vote on the plan.

meaningEN: A person or team that wins a competition.
commonMistakes: ❌ winner (فائز) وloser (خاسر) ضدّان؛ لا تخلط مع whiner (متذمر).
❌ صفة الفعل win هي winning وليس winny.
examples: The winner received a gold medal.
She is a clear winner of the debate.
The winner of the lottery has not come forward.
Everyone congratulated the winner.

meaningEN: Moving air; to turn something around.
commonMistakes: ❌ النطق اسم /wɪnd/ وفعل (لف) /waɪnd/ — مختلفان.
❌ لا تخلط wind مع wine (نبيذ).
examples: The wind is strong today.
The path winds through the hills.
She wound the rope around the pole.
Winds reached 100 km per hour.

meaningEN: To think and want to know; a feeling of surprise/awe.
commonMistakes: ❌ I wonder if... وليس I wonder that... للتساؤل.
❌ No wonder (لا عجب) بلا من: نفول no wonder he left وليس no wonder of.
examples: I wonder why she left early.
We wondered what to do next.
The child looked at the stars in wonder.
It's a wonder we finished on time.

meaningEN: Tasting sharp/bitter; involving strong feelings of anger or disappointment.
commonMistakes: ❌ bitter كطعم (مرّ) وsour (حامض) مختلفان.
❌ لا تخلط bitter مع bigger في النطق.
examples: The coffee tastes bitter.
She felt bitter about losing the job.
They had a bitter argument.
Winter here can be bitterly cold.

meaningEN: A space or break in something; a difference between things.
commonMistakes: ❌ gap year (سنة توقف عن الدراسة) وthe generation gap (فجوة الأجيال) مصطلحان.
❌ لا تخلط gap مع cap (قبعة/غطاء).
examples: There is a gap between the two buildings.
The age gap caused some conflict.
We need to close the skills gap.
A gap in the fence let the dog out.

meaningEN: Great respect; to respect someone publicly.
commonMistakes: ❌ in honour of (تكريماً لـ) وhonour a promise (يفي بوعده) معنيان.
❌ البريطاني يكتب honour والأمريكي honor — اختر واحداً وثبته.
examples: It is an honour to meet you.
The prize brought honour to the family.
They honoured him for his bravery.
She accepted the award with honour.

meaningEN: To guide or be in charge; a position ahead of others.

meaningEN: The way a person lives.

meaningEN: Behaving like an adult; fully grown; to become mature.

meaningEN: Born in a place; a person born in/connected to a place.

meaningEN: A person you compete or argue against.

meaningEN: To arrange things in a planned way.

meaningEN: First or new; not copied; an original work.

meaningEN: Money paid for something.
commonMistakes: ❌ payment (دفعة) وpayment gateway (بوابة دفع) مصطلحات مختلفة.

The loan requires monthly payments.
We accepted payment by card.

meaningEN: The highest point or level.
commonMistakes: ❌ peak (قمة وقتية/حادة) وsummit (قمة جبل/اجتماع) فرق دلالي.

meaningEN: A punishment for breaking a rule or law.

meaningEN: A feeling of happiness and enjoyment.
commonMistakes: ❌ with pleasure (بسرور) عبارة ثابتة رداً على طلب.

meaningEN: All the people living in a place.

meaningEN: An arranged time to meet someone; a job appointment.

meaningEN: Made by people; not natural.

meaningEN: The crime of starting a fire deliberately.

meaningEN: To state clearly and firmly; to claim a right.

meaningEN: Something valuable owned by a person or company.

Experience is a valuable asset.

meaningEN: Not typical; unusual.

Her audacious question impressed the panel.

meaningEN: Simple and plain; strict and serious in manner.

Employees enjoy autonomy in decision-making.
Autonomy helped the school improve.
The new law grants local autonomy.

meaningEN: To prevent something bad from happening; to turn your eyes away.

meaningEN: Too ordinary and boring, lacking originality.

meaningEN: To leave money or property in a will.

meaningEN: A public protest; showing how something works.

meaningEN: A strong wish or want.

meaningEN: Something out of its proper time period.
commonMistakes: ❌ anachronism (خطأ زمني) وanomaly (شذوذ) مختلفان.
❌ تُنطق /əˈnækrənɪzəm/ وليس /æn-æ-krən/.
examples: The film's phones are an anachronism for 1900.
Calling him a king is an anachronism.
The tradition seems an anachronism today.
An anachronism in the design confused historians.

meaningEN: A person who attacks established beliefs or institutions.
commonMistakes: ❌ iconoclast (كاسر تقليد) وheretic (زنديق) — الفرق في نوع المعسكر القديم.
❌ تُنطق /aɪˈkɒnəklæst/ — أصلها تحطيم الأيقونات.
examples: The professor is a well-known iconoclast.
An iconoclast challenges old thinking.
Her films made her the industry's iconoclast.
Every movement needs an iconoclast.

meaningEN: Very generous and forgiving, especially toward a defeated rival.
commonMistakes: ❌ magnanimous (سعة صدر) وgenerous (كرم مادي) — ماغناميموس أدبية أرقى.
❌ لا تخلط magnanimous مع mountain-ish في النطق.
examples: The champion was magnanimous in victory.
A magnanimous gesture ended the feud.
She was magnanimous to her critics.
Magnanimous leaders win loyalty.

meaningEN: The ability to recover quickly from difficulties; toughness
commonMistakes: resilience ≠ resistance (مرونة مقابل مقاومة)
examples: Resilience helps people cope with change.
The team showed great resilience during the crisis.
Building resilience is key to mental health.
